jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.</p></div><h3>Your Impact</h3> <p>You will be the technical authority for RF hardware behind Dedrone's airspace security products — the RF detection sensors that find and classify drones, and the countermeasure systems that defeat them. You own the hard RF problems end to end: wideband receive chains, high-power transmit chains, and their physical realization on board. You do not carry direct reports, but you technically lead a group of RF hardware engineers and antenna designers — you set the standards they design to, review their work, and grow their capability.&nbsp;This is a hands-on role. You will spend real time in simulation, on the bench, and in the chamber.</p> <h3>What You'll Do</h3> <p><strong>Location:</strong> This role is based out of our Kassel office and follows a hybrid schedule. We rely on in-person collaboration and ask that team members work onsite Tuesdays through Fridays, with the flexibility to work remotely on Mondays, unless there is an approved workplace accommodation. We believe that connection fuels innovation, and our in-office culture is designed to foster meaningful teamwork, mentorship, and shared success.<br><strong>Reports to:</strong> Director RF Engineering</p> <ul> <li>Own RF front-end architecture from VHF through SHF: link budgets, frequency planning, spurious and intermodulation analysis, sensitivity and dynamic-range trade-offs.</li> <li>Design and characterize mixers, high-power amplifiers, filters, and switching networks against demanding linearity, efficiency, and thermal targets.</li> <li>Drive board-level simulation (EM, circuit, and co-simulation) and take designs through multi-layer RF PCB layout, stack-up definition, and fabrication release.</li> <li>Lead bring-up, characterization, and design-for-test; close the loop between simulated and measured performance.</li> <li>Set and enforce RF design standards, review checklists, and documentation practice across the group.</li> <li>Mentor RF HW engineers and antenna designers; raise the technical bar through design reviews rather than rework.</li> <li>Partner with DSP, software, mechanical, and systems engineering, and with regulatory/compliance on CE, FCC, and MIL-STD qualification.</li> <li>Advise leadership on technology direction, build-vs-buy, and technical risk.</li> </ul> <h3>What You Bring</h3> <ul> <li>10+ years in RF hardware design, with a track record of products shipped to volume.</li> <li>Deep expertise across VHF, UHF, and SHF — not just one band.</li> <li>Demonstrated design ownership of mixers and high-power amplifiers above 10 W.</li> <li>Strong command of RF simulation tooling — EM and circuit solvers (e.g. ADS, AWR, HFSS, CST) — and the judgment to know when simulation is telling you the truth.</li> <li>Multi-layer RF PCB design: controlled impedance, material selection, grounding, isolation, thermal management.</li> <li>Fluent with VNAs, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and power measurement; comfortable debugging from first principles.</li> &

Wir laden dich ein, mit uns gemeinsam den Wandel voranzutreiben, indem wir kluge Köpfe mit einer gemeinsamen Vision zusammenbringen. Gemeinsam können wir das Paradigma, wie die Welt zusammenhängt, verändern. Unsere Technologie Die wachsende Nachfrage der Halbleiterindustrie nach leistungsfähigeren Chips mit höherer Bandbreite und geringerem Stromverbrauch findet ihre Lösung in unserer Technologie. Wir verbinden Chips mit Computernetzwerken mit hohem Durchsatz und geringer Verzögerung. Der Schlüssel liegt in der Nutzung der physikalischen Eigenschaften von Graphen, um elektronische Datenverarbeitung mit photonischer Kommunikation zu verbinden, so dass zahllose Chips miteinander interagieren können, als wären sie ein einziger. Unsere Graphen-Photonik-Innovation steigert die Rechenleistung und Effizienz in einer neuen Größenordnung. Deine Rolle In dieser Position verantwortest du die strategische Beschaffung und das Lieferantenmanagement für Materialien, die für die Fertigung von Halbleitern unverzichtbar sind. Darüber hinaus beobachtest du kontinuierlich die Märkte für Halbleitermaterialien, die Leistung der Lieferanten, Preistrends sowie Risiken in der Lieferkette, um Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen und gezielte Maßnahmen zur Risikominderung zu entwickeln. jobs.description: Founding Lead Engineer — AI & Workflow Automation Founders Factory builds and funds startups together with exceptional entrepreneurs and leading companies. Founded by experienced entrepreneurs, we combine early-stage capital with a hands-on Venture Studio team across product, engineering, growth, talent and fundraising. What we offer You’ll build the company from day one with capital and hands-on support from Founders Factory , working alongside an experienced venture team and with access to our network of founders, operators, corporate partners and investors. This is an opportunity to build first, validate quickly and potentially step in as Technical Co-Founder of an independent venture-backed company. Vorschläge entwickeln, wie sich unsere IT vereinfachen, standardisieren und wirtschaftlicher betreiben lässt. Teilzeit ca. 30 Wochenstunden Weitgehend eigenständige Betreuung der internen operativen IT. Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und viel Raum für eigene Ideen. Eine abwechslungsreiche technische Umgebung und die Chance, einen Linux- und Open-Source-orientierten Wandel mitzugestalten. Externe Unterstützung bei komplexen Infrastruktur- und Sicherheitsthemen. Überwiegend Tätigkeit am Standort Heiligenhaus

There is no room for abstraction for its own sake. Everything we build ends up in the hands of real operators in the field.</em></p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline; font-size: 10pt;"><strong>Your Mission</strong></span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>As a Robotics Engineer with a focus on embedded perception systems, you will play a critical role in enabling real-time autonomy onboard next-generation UAV platforms. Your work will be essential to ensuring that our autonomous systems operate reliably in real-world, resource-constrained environments.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p&

You will set the strategy for this dynamic function, create trust-based executive stakeholder relationships, implement best practices, mentor and develop the team, and personally manage multiple searches and candidate relationships.</p> <p>An important focus of this role is building trusted relationships with the highly matrixed EMEA leadership team, including regional and country leaders, and heads of Practices, Industries, and Service Lines. In addition, this role will often work with global leaders in the Americas and APAC. Strong communication skills, coupled with first-hand knowledge of local or country employment laws and customs, are very important.</p> <p>This role will be a culture carrier for the team and function, reinforcing a forward-looking, inclusive, collaborative, and creative work environment. You will create strong connections with candidates, helping guide them through a rigorous process with care and excellent communication. You will also oversee elements of the executive onboarding experience, in partnership with the People, Office, and IT teams. The role is vital to making sure everyone has the information they need, when they need it, while providing a seamless, thoughtful experience for all parties. In addition, you will play a meaningful role in ensuring our systems and processes work effectively and efficiently - and are compliant with firm policies and local laws and customs.</p> <p>AlixPartners is committed to our people’s growth, development, and career progression. jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering. We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock. We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters. We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us. The Role Due to our rapid growth and the sensitivity of our proprietary materials discovery platform, we are seeking a Security Engineer to ensure our innovation happens at speed without compromising the safety of our IP or our users. Your Impact In this role you will be building the automated security pipelines and AI-specific guardrails that protect our frontier models and research data, which is critical for maintaining the integrity of our materials discovery engine and the trust of our global partners. As an early security hire, you won't be a manual blocker; instead, you will architect a "shift-left" culture where security is a fundamental product feature. Your work ensures that as we scale our search for next-generation materials, our underlying infrastructure and world-class IP remain safely locked down. What You Will Do AI-Specific Security & IP Protection Secure the end-to-end ML lifecycle, implementing defenses against data poisoning and protecting our proprietary model weights from theft. Design and deploy prompt injection defenses and runtime firewalls to prevent unauthorized manipulation of our LLM interfaces. Implement AI Security Posture Management (AI-SPM) to monitor and catalog self-hosted models, internal training datasets, and proprietary endpoints. Cloud Security, CI/CD & Core DevSecOps Weave automated security “guardrails” directly into our CI/CD workflows, including secret scanning, API exposure checks, and software composition analysis (SCA). Codify security policies using Infrastructure as Code (IaC), ensuring all cloud resources are automatically compliant with global standards (e.g. GDPR, SOC2). Manage secrets and vulnerability patching for containerized environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) to ensure our research environment is resilient. Design strict, least-privilege Identity and Access Management (IAM) controls to isolate sensitive training data and research workloads. Interdisciplinary Collaboration & Security Culture Lead incident response efforts by monitoring production logs for anomalies and collaborating with AI Researchers to deploy rapid fixes. Empower the engineering team to own security by providing tools for local IDE security scanning and pre-commit hooks. Act as a security educator, cultivating a culture of shared responsibility across the AI, chemistry, and engineering teams. Partner with researchers, chemists, and engineers to translate security requirements into practical workflows that support rather than slow down scientific work. Must Have Skills and Qualifications: You are motivated by the mission of using AI for planetary-scale impact and understand the high stakes of securing "deep tech" intellectual property. 3+ years of experience in a DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Site Reliability Engineering role, preferably within a fast-paced startup or AI-centric company. Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins). Strong proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (e.g. Terraform, Pulumi)

jobs.title: Broker Development Manager
jobs.description: ABOUT FLOCK Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time. We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead. We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us! THE ROLE Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission. WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE: Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel. A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING: Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success. Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets. Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential. Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors. Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance. Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business. Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives. Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission. Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin. WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK: ESSENTIAL A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry. Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives. An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm. jobs.description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Legal Operations Specialist – Data Licensing on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the processes that let Mistral license content and data without slowing down. This role exists because we need someone who can turn legal analysis into repeatable workflows — managing rights, obligations, and restrictions across our growing dataset portfolio. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our commercial and legal agreements, turning their work into clear metadata, tracked obligations, and automated systems. Your impact will be visible in how smoothly data moves into our AI products: fewer bottlenecks, clearer rights status, and one reliable record for every data agreement we sign. You will sit where copyright, data protection, and AI meet, making sure that as we acquire and use training data, we comply with EU and US law, respect third-party rights, and enforce the restrictions our contracts impose. In scope: clearing permissions for inbound data, reviewing and codifying contracts, maintaining a central rights-and-obligations database, and building AI-powered workflows that make all of this scalable. What You Will Do Clear inbound data usage requests by researching rights status, scope, obligations, and restrictions — including anonymization and data protection requirements — before data enters our systems. Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining our template library and playbook alongside Legal. Assess whether specific AI use cases fall within the scope of third-party agreements, flag gaps, and recommend contract amendments. Build and maintain a central database that serves as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement. Track and manage compliance with ongoing obligations — permitted uses, confidentiality, re-use rights — automate our reporting, and administer master licensing partnerships. Verify provenance, ownership, and consent for acquired data, and identify obligations that require active monitoring. Monitor that Mistral clients and partners stay within their granted rights, operating the approval system that enforces legal restrictions. Design and run AI-powered workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts. What We're Looking For A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration — ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment. Working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently. Meticulous attention to detail and discretion with confidential contracts, combined with strong project-management skills. Clear, direct communication and the initiative to anticipate needs through ambiguity. A legal-ops mindset: you want to turn legal analysis into repeatable, scalable processes, not just handle one-off reviews. Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment — you are an AI power user, ideally with experience setting up such workflows in a legal team. If you enjoy owning the full journey from customer problem to shipped product—and you're excited by AI, automation, and short-term rentals—we want to meet you. jobs.description: Health can’t wait . Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way. So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience. We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture . We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR. Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond. ⭐️ The Senior Revenue Operations job Our Business Strategy & Operations team runs the most critical, strategic, and data-driven projects at Alan. It sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Finance, and covers four core areas: sales strategy and planning, sales effectiveness, sales enablement, and business segment leadership. You'll be joining the Sales Effectiveness team , whose mission is to make our sales organization run at its best across France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada. jobs.title: Stage assistant chef de projet évènementiel (H/F/X) - Lyon
jobs.description: Le stage se déroulera au sein du service Sensibilisation-Communication de Handicap International, au siège de Lyon, du 1er avril au 30 septembre 2027. Il contribuera à la préparation et à l’animation des Pyramides de chaussures 2027, ainsi qu’à l’organisation d’autres événements de l’association.Les Pyramides de chaussures c’est le temps fort de sensibilisation et de mobilisation citoyenne pour Handicap International. Depuis plus de 30 ans, tous les citoyens, scolaires, salariés d’entreprises, sympathisants de Handicap International ou encore politiques sont invités à venir : -          Lancer leurs chaussures pour témoigner de leur soutien aux causes portées par Handicap International, la chaussure symbole du poids de l’engagement citoyen pour protéger les civils ; -          S’informer à travers une exposition interactive, ludique et pédagogique sur Handicap International, ses champs d’intervention et ses combats ; -          Rencontrer et échanger avec nos experts terrain.   Pour en savoir plus sur les Pyramides : https://www.handicap-international.fr/fr/pyramides-de-chaussures Le stage associe coordination événementielle, relations avec les partenaires et prestataires, recrutement et animation de la communauté de bénévoles, préparation de supports et de matériel, animation et participation aux événements. En complément, nous vous invitons à prendre connaissance des actions de sensibilisation et mobilisation en consultant : l’Espace du bénévolat et de la sensibilisation pour Handicap International . La mission se déroulera du 1e avril au 30 septembre 2027 (6 mois). Vos missions sont les suivantes Activité 1 : Vous appuyez l’organisation et la coordination des Pyramides de chaussures de Villeurbanne et Paris avec ·       La participation à la conception et à la logistique opérationnelle des Pyramides (scénographies, matériel, présence sur événement, montage/démontage). ·       L’appui au recrutement, à l’animation et au suivi des bénévoles, ainsi qu’à leur formation et fidélisation. ·       La coordination de la Journée des Scolaires et l’organisation des visites guidées pour tous les publics. ·       La recherche de prestataires. ·       La contribution aux bilans : recueillir les retours des équipes et partenaires, documenter les résultats et proposer des améliorations pour les prochaines éditions. Activité 2 : Vous participez à l’organisation d’autres événements de Handicap International ·       Congrès des Notaires : contribuer à la définition et à l’adaptation des messages clés, à la conception du stand et du parcours de sensibilisation, à la préparation des supports, du matériel et d’un kit d’animation, ainsi qu’à l’organisation. ·       Vœux 2028 : participer à la recherche et à la sélection d’un lieu insolite adapté à l’événement, imaginer des propositions d’animation et contribuer à l’identification, à la consultation et au suivi des prestataires. ·       Plus largement, apporter un appui à la coordination, à la logistique et au suivi des événements transversaux de l’Association Nationale France. Activité 3 – Participer à la vie quotidienne du service Sensibilisation-Communication ·       Contribuer à la gestion de boîtes mail et au suivi des sollicitations, au suivi d’actions solidaires et à la préparation de nouvelles actions ou événements de mobilisation. ·       Contribuer à l'animation et au déploiement du défi de Damien Seguin pour l'inclusion et la solidarité internationale, avec un focus sur le volet scolaire : mobilisation et accompagnement des établissements scolai

jobs.title: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation - Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F)
jobs.description: Ingénieur Conception & Instrumentation – Équipements et bancs d’essais (H/F) À propos de notre client Notre client est une TPE basée au nord de Lyon, spécialisée dans les énergies du sous-sol : pétrole, gaz, géothermie et stockage de CO2. Son activité repose entièrement sur la R&D : essais sur géomatériaux, géomécanique et développement d'équipements d'essais pour des clients internationaux. Son équipe pluridisciplinaire et multiculturelle développe des solutions technologiques innovantes au service de l'efficacité, de la protection de l'environnement et de la maîtrise des coûts. L'entreprise est certifiée ISO 9001 et toutes ses activités respectent sa démarche QHSE. Le poste Votre rôle : mettre au point de véritables méthodes d’essai. À partir d’un besoin de mesure (température, pression, déplacement, déformation, ultrasons…), vous concevez, instrumentez et validez des cellules d’essais haute température et haute pression. Vous commencez par fiabiliser une cellule existante : simplifier son montage et son démontage, puis la valider à plus haute température. Vous lancez ensuite les cellules suivantes. Vous travaillez avec l’équipe qui conçoit aujourd’hui les équipements, et avec le bureau d’études d’un fabricant partenaire qui réalise la conception détaillée et les plans de fabrication. Environ 70-80 % conception et développement, 20-30 % laboratoire. Rattachement à la direction des opérations. Ce que le poste n’est pas : ni dessinateur ou calculateur (le détail et les plans sont externalisés), ni management d’équipe.  Vos missions Définir le besoin, le cahier des charges et le pré-dimensionnement fonctionnel de nouvelles cellules. Choisir les capteurs adaptés et les intégrer ; résoudre les enjeux d’étanchéité, de tenue en température et en pression. Consulter fournisseurs et sous-traitants, suivre la fabrication des pièces. Monter, instrumenter et tester vous-même vos équipements au laboratoire ; interpréter les mesures et améliorer. Améliorer l’ergonomie des équipements existants et transférer les équipements validés à l’équipe d’essais. Rédiger la documentation technique et contribuer à la protection de la propriété intellectuelle. Requirements Indispensable Conception mécanique d’équipements, avec une CAO 3D (aucun logiciel imposé). Instrumentation, capteurs et techniques de mesure physique et physico-chimique : choisir et intégrer, pas fabriquer. Goût du terrain : vous aimez monter, démonter et intervenir vous-même sur les équipements. Important Gestion de projet : planning, budget, fournisseurs. Rigueur, autonomie, communication proactive des difficultés. Un plus Anglais technique (échanges écrits avec des fournisseurs étrangers). Mise en plan, notions de matériaux et d’isolation thermique. Expérience en pression ou température. Formation et expérience Diplôme d’ingénieur (bac +5) en mécanique, génie physique, instrumentation ou mesures physiques. Un parcours associant mécanique et mesures physiques (BUT Mesures physiques puis école d’ingénieurs en mécanique) est particulièrement apprécié. Environ 5 ans d’expérience en conception d’équipements, bureau d’études ou R&D ; profils plus juniors étudiés. Poste orienté conception et terrain : une thèse n’est pas requise. Conditions Sur site. Manutention occasionnelle de pièces métalliques lourdes avec moyens de levage. Intéressement Rémunération : 36 – 48 k€ brut annuel selon expérience Benefits Vous rejoindrez une entreprise à taille humaine où chaque développement compte : vos équipements seront directement utilisés pour des projets de R&D menés pour des clients internationaux. Vous travaillerez au sein d'une équipe dynamique et multiculturelle, sur des sujets techniques exigeants au service des énergies du sous-sol et de la transition énergétique. jobs.title: Conversion Rate Optimisation Manager
jobs.description: At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods. We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice. This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience. Responsibilities Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction. Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands. Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights. Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale. Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges. Qualifications Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams. Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools. The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries. Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights. Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps. You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business. When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions. Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days

jobs.title: AI Project Manager
jobs.description: ParetoLabs is looking for an experienced and structured (Senior) AI Project Manager to lead AI projects for our clients from first idea to production. You will scope projects, steer delivery and make sure what we ship creates real value in Swiss companies across a wide range of industries. Data & Compliance: Awareness of data protection (Swiss FADP, GDPR) and information security in client projects. Communication Skills: Excellent German and English, written and spoken. Mindset: Structured, hands-on and curious, with the ownership to bring projects over the finish line. Marketing Automation: Maintain and scale lifecycle workflows, lead scoring mechanisms, drip sequences, and automated triggers to optimize lead conversion through the relevant funnel. Rapid A/B & Multivariate Testing: Design, set up, and evaluate rapid growth experiments (copy variants, landing page layouts, audience segmentation, offer positioning) on a weekly sprint cycle. 3. AI Pipeline Operation & Content QA Automated Workflow Orchestration: Build, maintain, and optimize AI-driven content pipelines to generate high-quality marketing assets at scale. Human-in-the-Loop Quality Assurance: Establish strict QA processes to review, refine, and approve AI

We leren al doende en blijven continu verbeteren in hoe we onze klanten helpen. In deze rol betekent dat vooral: jij bent de eigenaar van onze cijfers. Dit wordt jouw baan Als projectontwikkelaar leid je vastgoedprojecten van concept tot realisatie. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de ontwikkeling, verkoop en het volledige procesmanagement. Van haalbaarheidsstudies tot de start van de bouw: jij houdt het overzicht. Je onderhoudt relaties met partners, beleggers, woningcorporaties en overheden en zorgt voor een vlotte samenwerking tussen alle betrokkenen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamspeler die bij gebiedsontwikkelingen bijdraagt aan het realiseren van impact op jouw (deel)project. Dankzij je ervaring met complexe projecten (appartementen en binnenstedelijke ontwikkelingen) weet je snel te schakelen tussen belanghebbenden en bewaak je het totaalplaatje, inclusief conceptontwikkeling, duurzaamheid, budget en planning. Wat ga je doen? Markt & Klant: Analyseren van de marktvraag en het ontwikkelen van passende product-marktcombinaties. Opstellen van grond- en vastgoedexploitaties en coördineren van verkooptrajecten. Onderhouden en uitbouwen van relaties met beleggers en woningcorporaties. Locatie & RO: Begeleiden van RO-procedures en vergunningstrajecten. Organisatie: Coördineren van het ontwikkelings- en ontwerpproces, inclusief de financiële en commerciële aspecten. Tijd & Geld: Opstellen en bewaken van exploitaties en planningen, uitvoeren van risicoanalyses en voeren van onderhandelingen om de beste resultaten te behalen. Jij hebt als geen ander gevoel voor het sluiten van goede deals. Meer bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer is een onafhankelijk familiebedrijf. En dat merk je. In hoe we samenwerken, naar elkaar omkijken en bouwen met oog voor de volgende generaties. Al sinds 1855 bouwen we aan Nederland, in woningbouw, utiliteitsbouw, infrastructuur en techniek. Onze onafhankelijkheid en lange termijn visie vormen daarbij de basis. Met een omzet van € 2,6 miljard en ruim 3.700 collega’s behoren we tot de top van de Nederlandse bouwsector. Maar uiteindelijk draait het bij ons niet om die cijfers. Het draait om mensen. Om collega’s die samen werken aan projecten waar je trots op bent – iconisch én dichtbij – en bijdragen aan oplossingen voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken. Onze ambities zijn groot. En die maken we alleen waar met betrokken mensen. Daarom investeren we in goed werkgeverschap en een werkomgeving waarin jij je thuis voelt. Waar je jezelf kunt zijn, je veilig voelt en je uitspreekt. Zodat jij het beste uit jezelf haalt en samen met ons meer  maakt. Focus op vastgoed bij Dura Vermeer Dura Vermeer heeft grote ambities als ontwikkelaar. In onze portefeuille vind je uitdagende (gebieds)ontwikkelingen met onderscheidende concepten, veelal op binnenstedelijke locaties. Ons werkgebied beslaat Zuid-Holland, waar we de stedelijke uitdagingen omarmen en maximale waarde willen toevoegen in onze plannen. Dit resulteert in projecten waar je echt impact kunt maken op gebieden als stedenbouw, architectuur, duurzaamheid en sociale cohesie. Als organisatie groeien we naar een vestiging waar jaarlijks 800 woningen risicodragend worden geacquireerd en verkocht. Dit betekent dat we zelf het risico dragen van de aankoop tot verkoop van de woningen. Jij speelt een belangrijke rol in onze complexe ontwikkelingen. Dura Vermeer onderscheidt zich op het gebied van samenwerking. We werken nauw samen met gemeentes, partners en stakeholders binnen onze projecten, en zeker ook met onze collega’s in Rotterdam. We staan bekend om onze intensieve en oprechte samenwerking, die leidt tot innovatieve en duurzame oplossingen in elk project. Op nationaal niveau heeft Dura Vermeer een sterke vastgoedorganisatie waar je op kunt terugvallen. Regelmatig on

Dat doe je niet alleen: je werkt samen met enthousiaste collega’s in een projectteam. Voordelen voor de sollicitant Als projectmanager krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid, help je klanten en samen met je projectteam zet je mooie resultaten neer. Je kunt deels thuiswerken, deels op ons kantoor in Woerden en bij verschillende klanten in Nederland. Tijdelijk werken vanuit het buitenland kan ook dankzij onze workation-regeling (maximaal 30 dagen aaneengesloten per jaar). Bij ons draait het om klantgericht werken én werkplezier. Daarom is er volop ruimte voor ontspanning en plezier. Denk aan een levend tafelvoetbaltoernooi, pubquiz en een bier- & wijnproeverij. Ons actieve Fun-team zorgt elke maand weer voor iets leuks. En als je reislust nog niet is gestild met 25 vakantiedagen en een workation, dan kun je zelfs tot 20 extra verlofdagen bijkopen. Genoeg redenen om verder te lezen en te ontdekken of deze functie iets voor jou is, toch? Hierin bespreken jullie de voortgang, resultaten en eventuele hulpvragen. Na de dagstart: Allereerst neem je nog wat tijd met een van de consultants naar aanleiding van de dagstart. Wat zijn de belangrijkste punten voor de klant en voor CCS en hoe vliegen we die aan. Na de lunch: Je checkt nog een paar tickets qua voortgang op het planboard, waarbij je de samenhang met de planning checkt. Vervolgens ga je naar de werksessie met het CCS projectmanagement guild. Hier werken jullie aan tickets om de CCS Prince2Agile projectmethodiek verder te verbeteren. Hierna heb je nog een afspraak met je collega van sales voor afstemming over een mogelijk vervolgproject bij de klant. Daarbij ben je in staat om de klantverwachtingen helder te analyseren, te managen en actief bij te sturen waar nodig; · Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal uitstekend in woord en geschrift; · Jouw persoonlijkheid kenmerkt zich door: gestructureerd, motiverend, communicatief sterk, duidelijk, open, tikje eigenwijs, enthousiast, relativerend, creatief en pragmatisch; · Je haalt energie uit het opstellen en bewaken van planningen, analyseren van gegevens en opstellen van duidelijke, gestructureerde rapportages en presentaties; · Je hebt minimaal een afgeronde bachelor, bij voorkeur richting bedrijfskunde, bedrijfseconomie en/of informatica. jobs.title: Stagiair(e) Energie en Leefomgeving
jobs.description: 31-38,75 uur per week | Utrecht | Hybride | € 600,– stagevergoeding | Wo-bachelor/-master | 6-12 maanden Jouw vooruitgang begint bij Berenschot De energietransitie is in volle gang. Overheden en bedrijven werken toe naar het behalen van Europese en landelijke doelstellingen, maar dit is vaak makkelijker gezegd dan gedaan. Om beleid tot uitvoering te brengen, moeten uiteenlopende belangen, overtuigingen en visies bijeenkomen. De grenzen tussen beleid en uitvoering zijn daarbij soms vaag. Op dat snijvlak werken wij: wat is de beste strategie om de doelen te behalen, en hoe werken we daar samen naartoe? Daar heb je kennis van de energietransitie voor nodig, maar ook gevoel voor mensen, context en organisaties. Dit is uitdagend, complex en leuk! Wil jij meewerken aan de meest urgente energie- en klimaatvraagstukken van Nederland? Wil jij met frisse ideeën en nieuwe inzichten bijdragen aan oplossingen voor uiteenlopende organisaties? En ben je benieuwd naar het werk bij een adviesbureau? Berenschot biedt jou de kans om tijdens een stage actief mee te werken aan deze complexe en actuele uitdagingen! De startdatum van je stage is 1 oktober 2026 (in overleg). Dit ga je doen Als stagiair(e) werk je onder andere mee aan opdrachten die gaan over energiesystemen, netcongestie, de warmtetransitie, betaalbaarheid en systeemweerbaarheid, op landelijk, regionaal én lokaal niveau. Opdrachtgevers zijn overheden (ministeries, provincies, gemeenten), netbeheerders, energiebedrijven, uitvoeringsorganisaties en woningbouwcorporaties. Daarbij werken we niet alleen voor, maar vooral ook mét onze opdrachtgevers. Een aantal voorbeelden van opdrachten waaraan wij werk(t)en: Het uitdenken en opbouwen van grote nationale uitvoeringsprogramma’s van het Klimaatakkoord, zoals  het Nationaal Programma RES, het Nationaal Programma Lokale Warmtetransitie, het Nationaal Plan Energiesysteem, en programma’s rondom hernieuwbare opwek (zon op dak, wind op land, etc.). Het begeleiden van (grote) gemeenten bij het ontwikkelen van een warmte(net)strategie. Het ondersteunen van netbeheerders en provincies bij de ontwikkeling en programmering van het energiesysteem van de toekomst (Energievisies) en het verminderen van netcongestie. Overheden helpen met het opstellen van effectief klimaatbeleid met behulp van prognoses op basis van onze eigen Regionale CO2-routekaart. Het uitvoeren van volumeprojecties voor waterstofdragers richting 2035, om inzicht te krijgen in de verschillende stromen en knelpunten. Het ontwikkelen van een alternatief nettariefstelsel voor netbeheerders, waarmee de netbelasting wordt gespreid en netcongestie wordt beperkt. Overheden helpen met het opstellen en uitvoeren van beleid en plannen om de energietransitie rechtvaardiger te maken (bijvoorbeeld door bestrijding van energiearmoede, de inzet van fix-teams, het sturen op isolatie, etc.) Tijdens jouw stage krijg je de kans om mee te werken aan adviesopdrachten en lever je een bijdrage aan interne projecten, zoals bijvoorbeeld evenementen. Welke adviesopdrachten je doet, bepalen we samen met jou (afhankelijk van jouw interesses, achtergrond en kennis, en welke opdrachten er lopen). Quote “De variatie aan projecten, klanten en collega’s zorgt ervoor dat je snel een beeld krijgt van wat je doet als consultant. Je werkt als stagiair(e) écht mee aan maatschappelijk relevante projecten!” Hier kom je terecht Berenschot is een zelfstandig en onafhankelijk organisatieadviesbureau in Utrecht, waar we met meer dan 500 gedreven collega’s werken aan duurzame oplossingen voor de vraagstukken van onze opdrachtgevers. We dragen bij aan vooruitgang in organisaties en de maatschappij met onze adviezen en oplossingen. Onze organisatie heeft een platte structuur zonder partners, waardoor je invloed hebt op de projecten die je uitvoert. We streven altijd naar verrassende en vernieuwende oplossingen, wat ons uniek maakt. Met een open en informele cultuur, samenwerking tussen verschillende vakgebieden en veel vrijhe

jobs.description: Monumental is automating on-site construction with robotics and software. Our mission is to make construction software-defined and autonomous - a future where beautiful, bespoke buildings go up in a single day, with minimal labour. It's still the early days of building the company, and this is a chance to make an outsized impact on a problem that matters. From day one, you’ll be working with an experienced founding team, backed by a $32M Series B led by Khosla Ventures and Plural. Monumental is based in the city centre of Amsterdam, in a beautiful facility with an fully equipped workshop and robot testing floor. We build the whole stack in-house - hardware and software, we're explicitly not a hybrid or remote-first company - you can't build robots or walls from home, so we're onsite five days a week. We're taking on more construction projects - "deployments" - every month, with more robots, more people, and now in new markets as we scale from the Netherlands into the UK and US. As Hub Lead, you’ll stand up our first hub outside HQ, in the north of the Netherlands. You’ll start by running our largest deployment to date, then build the team and operations around it as the project pipeline ramps up behind you. jobs.description: About Us QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. As our Quantum Hardware Assembly Technician at QuantWare, you are the hands that turn a quantum chip into a working, measurable product. Your precision, discipline and reliability directly keep our production and measurement pipelines moving, and ensure our quantum hardware meets the highest quality standards. This is a hands-on execution role . You carry out chip assembly and fridge loading according to technical drawings and documented work instructions (SOPs), to a consistent quality standard and pace, and you record your work in our production systems. You report to the Production Manager , who holds formal line-management responsibility (1:1s, performance reviews, absence and leave). Load our cryogenic fridges with new chips to be measured , mounting packaged samples and QPUs, making the wiring, thermal and mechanical connections, and closing up the system with magnetic shields. Able to read work instructions with photos and technical drawings, and comfortable with basic digital tools and production systems. Good with your hands at two scales: precision in assembly, handling of fine devices and connectors, and mechanical assembly such as bolting, cabling and fitting larger parts together. Our platform brings together the world's leading geospatial providers, and offers a single touchpoint to access, manage, and process data at scale. From vegetation management and infrastructure monitoring to disaster response, UP42 helps organizations across industries find solutions to complex problems through Earth observation. Our expert support team and detailed documentation guide our users through every step. Since July 2025, UP42 has been a part of Neo Space Group. We are looking for a Senior Sales Manager & Team Lead, EMEA  (m/f/x) to join our Sales team in Berlin (hybrid) or remotely in Germany. Our EMEA team is growing into large European enterprises, and our enterprise go-to-market is still maturing. In this role you sell to those enterprises yourself, and you coach our Sales Managers in the region. Most of your results will come from your own sales, and you will work closely with Marketing and Customer Success teams. What you will do: Drive strategic pipeline and account growth with large European enterprises in energy, finance, insurance and infrastructure. Win and grow strategic enterprise opportunities with our Earth Observation platform. Build relationships with some of Europe's largest enterprise accounts. Deliver your annual sales targets with a healthy and repeatable enterprise pipeline. Coach and mentor your team members, and help them capture and manage complex enterprise opportunities. Improve deal quality, deal progression and forecasting across the EMEA team. Strengthen enterprise selling discipline as our enterprise go-to-market matures. Here is a good summary of what we are looking for: Significant years of sales experience within the geospatial industry, including Earth observation, remote sensing, GIS platform sales, satellite imagery, LiDAR, or adjacent technologies Proven success selling data and/or platforms into enterprise customers, including managing long sales cycles and complex buying committees Enterprise sales experience in the European market Strong track record of sourcing, structuring, and closing high-value deals while carrying and consistently achieving quota Willingness to act as player-coach and to mentor others Ability to guide and develop experienced sellers Track record of planning pipeline and delivering deals in line with forecast Knowledge of remote sensing and geospatial markets in Europe, with vertical expertise in energy, finance, insurance or infrastructure Bonus points if you bring: Team management experience Let us tell you why UP42 is a good choice: Let's disrupt the industry: You get the chance to shape the state-of-the-art geospatial processing platform and create a completely new planetary perspective. Let's stay flexible: We practice a hybrid working model - you can choose when to work from the comfort of your home or join your colleagues in our modern office in the heart of Kreuzberg, or even from a global place of your choice up to 90 days per year. Let's win as a team: We're an inspiring international team working in a fun and productive environment. Let's be fair: We offer a competitive salary package and other perks such as wellbeing initiatives, sponsored fitness subscriptions, educational budget for your personal development and public transportation discount - just to name a few. Let's enjoy the good side of life: Gather in regular team events as well as our global company parties twice a year. Let's think outside of the box: There are challenges and enough space for creativity and taking ownership. Does this sound like a good next step into your geospatial career? If so, we look forward to receiving your application in English. Our culture is one of belonging, where everyone feels welcome and where differences are celebrated. We seek to recruit the best talent regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orien

jobs.title: Senior Partner
jobs.description: About the Role A legal technology company is seeking a Germany-based Senior Partner to help grow an AI-enabled legal practice. You will bring an established client portfolio, continue advising those clients, and work with the team to move recurring legal matters onto AI-assisted workflows. What You'll Do Bring your portable client portfolio to the firm and continue serving those clients. Build relationships with private equity, venture capital, and mid-market clients to support business development. Identify opportunities to provide commercial and compliance services across your client network. Work with the founding team to assess and automate recurring legal matters using AI tools and agent-based workflows. Help shape the firm's growth and represent its legal services in the market. What We're Looking For 12 to 20 or more years of German legal practice, including experience at partner level. A German-qualified Volljurist admitted as a Rechtsanwalt, with native-level German and professional English. A personally held, portable book of business valued at €1 million or more, with a diversified client base and relationships that can transition with you. Experience serving private equity or venture capital clients and their portfolio companies, with recurring work in areas such as commercial contracts, IT and data, corporate matters, or regulatory compliance. Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or legal AI products, and a demonstrated interest in updating legal workflows through automation. Ability to work in Germany and a feasible path to transition your client work. Compensation & Benefits Base salary: €200,000 to €300,000 annually. The role includes meaningful equity. Visa sponsorship is not available. Location Remote within Germany, with Berlin as the primary location. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.title: Senior Account Manager- Kraken Flexibility (German Speaking)
jobs.description: Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe! Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy. We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide. It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone. Kraken is seeking an exceptional Senior Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of Flexibility clients across Europe. The role is responsible for building trusted stakeholder relationships, coordinating priorities across Kraken teams and helping clients grow and realise value from Kraken's portfolio of Flexibility products and services. Working across multiple clients and markets, you'll need strong stakeholder management, prioritisation and communication skills. We're looking for a highly organised, proactive self-starter who can build trust, create clarity from complexity and drive progress in a fast-moving environment. Experience of flexibility markets is highly advantageous. However, we also welcome exceptional candidates who can demonstrate strong stakeholder management, commercial awareness and an ability to drive outcomes in complex environments. Fluency in one or more European languages, particularly German, would be valuable given the importance of the German market within our European client portfolio. The role offers an opportunity to work with some of the most innovative flexibility clients in Europe and play a key role in supporting Kraken's continued international growth. What you'll do Own and develop a portfolio of Flexibility client accounts across Europe. Act as the primary point of coordination for your portfolio of clients, primarily Residential Flex and, where appropriate, Generation Flex services. Identify opportunities to help clients grow their flexibility programmes and increase the value delivered through Kraken's products and services. Act as a cross-functional leader, aligning priorities across Delivery, Product, Engineering and Customer Success, bringing together the right people to deliver successful client outcomes. Be the client advocate within Kraken whilst balancing the needs of the wider business. Maintain a deep understanding of high-priority features, client commitments and critical incidents so that you can communicate confidently with stakeholders and proactively drive delivery progress by ensuring risks, dependencies and blockers are actively managed. Provide clear communication, challenge constructively and hold stakeholders accountable for agreed outcomes. Facilitate client governance, including QBRs, service reviews, strategic planning sessions and product roadmap reviews appropriate to the needs and maturity of each client. Prepare client reporting, account health and forecasting updates. Lead commercial discussions where required. Ensure clients achieve meaningful outcomes and realise value from Kraken's Flexibility products and services. What you'll need Experience managing client relationships in a client-facing environment. Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities simultaneously. Ability to influence and align Product, Engineering, Delivery and Customer Success teams around shared client outcomes. Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills. Highly organised, proactive and able to operate independently. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Ability to lead through influence and create clarity in ambiguous situations. Comfortable navigating difficult conversations and holding others accountable. Resilient, accountable and delivery focused Demonstrated ability to build trusted relationships. Preferred Experience Energy

jobs.description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. jobs.description: <p>SumUp's tax function is scaling to match a business that now spans more than 40 entities. This role is a senior partner to the Head of Tax across the Group's tax agenda. You'll lead the implementation and operationalisation of corporate income tax, transfer pricing, and indirect tax strategy, and you'll help shape the positions and policies behind it. jobs.description: <p>Four models in production today. Fifteen to twenty by mid-2027. The shared pipeline that gets them there has to hold — and you own everything after handoff: packaging, deployment, drift detection, and the call on whether a model is fit to serve.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> Central Berlin — you work from our office, hybrid with 3 days office and 2 days home office.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>About us</h3> <p>CarOnSale is the AI-powered platform for B2B used car trading in Europe. Over 40,000 buyers from more than 20 countries trade on our platform — and 85% of inventory is exclusive to us. We connect software, pricing intelligence, logistics and financing in one layer — as the operating system for an entire industry.</p> <p><em><strong>One Platform. One Profit Engine.</strong></em></p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>The platform you build in</h3> <p>Our machine learning runs on one shared, central platform — not a separate pipeline per model. Five canonical stages: data extraction, validation, transformation, training and evaluation. A Snowflake data warehouse feeds a SageMaker managed feature store, and models reach production through governed CI/CD promotion lanes on Terraform-managed AWS infrastructure. Your job is to build inside it and make it stronger, so the next model costs less to ship than the last one.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>Your responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>You own models from handoff through to production: packaging, deployment, monitoring, and the decision on whether a model is ready to serve</li> <li>You keep production models reliable — drift detection, performance monitoring, alerting and incident response when something moves</li> <li>You own the serving and inference path: fitted pipeline artifacts, inference entry points, monitoring hooks and feature-store parity</li> <li>You review model design and evaluation methodology before anything ships, and catch data leakage, backward-window errors and weak evaluation during development, while they are still cheap to fix</li> <li>You extend the shared platform so it stays useful for every model, without project-specific logic leaking into shared code</li> <li>You set the engineering standards the platform runs on as it scales across the organisation</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3>What you bring</h3> <ul> <li>4+ years in production machine learning engineering, with real ownership of models after handoff — not only training them</li> <li>Strong Python: typed, tested, production-grade code, and you review the work of others</li> <li>Enough machine learning depth to challenge a pipeline on problem framing, feature engineering, model selection and evaluation methodology</li> <li>Hands-on experience with a managed ML platform — SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks or Azure ML — plus feature stores, CI/CD for machine learning, AWS and Terraform</li> <li>An AI-native way of working: you use tools like Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot actively in your daily work</li> <li>English at C1 level, written and spoken. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy. Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role As the Global Onboarding & Enablement Operations Program Manager at ElevenLabs, you’ll help keep our global GTM onboarding and enablement programmes running smoothly as we grow. You’ll lead the day-to-day delivery of onboarding, making sure every new GTM hire gets a consistent, engaging start, while building the structure and processes that help the wider Enablement team work more effectively and scale its impact. You’ll bring structure to how we plan, deliver and measure enablement, from tracking OKRs and roadmaps to coordinating the enablement calendar, launches and certifications. You’ll also help keep the team aligned on priorities, manage cross-functional dependencies and use reporting to understand what’s working and where we can improve. Working closely with the Sales Enablement lead and partners across GTM, RevOps, Product Marketing and People, you’ll help turn priorities into well-run programmes that meet the needs of the business. This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys bringing order to complex projects, delivering engaging training and finding practical, creative ways to solve problems. Own GTM onboarding: Manage onboarding cohorts end to end, from scheduling and communications to facilitating live sessions, coordinating speakers and gathering feedback. jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel (f/m/d)
jobs.description: <h2>Purpose of Position</h2> <p>Awin's Legal team advises the group on its legal rights and obligations across a global affiliate and partnership network. As Senior Legal Counsel, you will be a trusted, hands-on partner to our commercial, product and leadership teams, leading complex negotiations, supporting M&amp;A and strategic transactions, and helping the business grow across Europe, the UK, the US and beyond. You will report directly to the General Counsel.</p> <p>We are looking for a pragmatic, business-enabling lawyer who enjoys solving problems, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited about how AI is changing both our industry and the way legal teams work. If you enjoy working across cultures and jurisdictions, join us full-time in one of our hubs, London or Berlin, or work from another country where Awin has an office – you can choose.</p> <h2>Key Tasks</h2> <ul> <li>Leading the drafting, review and negotiation of complex, high-value commercial agreements with advertisers, publishers, agencies, technology partners and vendors, including MSAs, SaaS and platform terms, partnership agreements, DPAs and NDAs</li> <li>Acting as the go-to legal partner for commercial teams across regions, giving consistent, risk-weighted and business-focused advice that helps close deals</li> <li>Advising on cross-jurisdictional corporate, commercial, competition, intellectual property and regulatory matters under EU, UK, US and other international legal frameworks</li> <li>Supporting M&amp;A and strategic transactions end to end, from due diligence and transaction documents to corporate approvals and post-merger integration</li> <li>Managing disputes, litigation and third-party information requests such as subpoenas, together with external counsel</li> <li>Working with the Privacy team on the commercial and contractual side of data protection, including GDPR, UK GDPR, US state privacy laws and other regimes</li> <li>Shaping how Legal uses AI: introducing AI tools and workflows that make the team more efficient, and advising the business on the legal aspects of AI, including the EU AI Act</li> <li>Improving templates, playbooks and legal processes, and delivering practical training to non-lawyers</li> </ul> <h2>Skills &amp; Expertise</h2> <ul> <li>Qualified as a solicitor or barrister in England and Wales and/or admitted to practise as an attorney in a US state</li> <li>5+ years' post-qualification experience, ideally in-house in an international business or at a law firm handling comparable commercial work</li> <li>Strong track record in complex commercial negotiations, ideally in affiliate or performance marketing, or in a related sector such as tech, SaaS, AdTech or e-commerce; experience with US commercial contracts, litigation, subpoenas and dispute resolution is a plus</li> <li>Solid M&amp;A experience, including due diligence, transaction documentation and post-closing integration</li> <li>Working knowledge of data protection laws such as GDPR, UK GDPR and US state privacy laws is an advantage</li> <li>Native or native-level English, with excellent drafting and communication skills and the ability to explain complex legal, technical and business matters clearly to non-lawyers; jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: About Peec AI Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win. We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, that went from $0 to $15M ARR in 18 months, with a 100+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our New York office. About the role Peec AI is building the data plane for AI visibility: millions of chats, scrapes, citations, sources, model responses, and customer-facing insights running through a fast-moving backend. This role is for an engineer who wants to own the systems behind that. You will not just add endpoints or close tickets. You will make our scraping, chat-processing, source-ingestion, and analytics infrastructure more reliable, cheaper, faster, and easier for the rest of the team to reason about. The best fit looks like someone who can debug a provider outage in the morning, design a better queueing model before lunch, ship a TypeScript service change in the afternoon, and write the postmortem or follow-up ticket clearly enough that the next engineer immediately knows what to do. We are especially interested in people who have built or operated systems with real constraints: rate limits, flaky third-party APIs, queues, webhooks, retries, distributed locks, data migrations, observability gaps, customer pressure, and cost ceilings. What we’re looking for 5+ years of backend, platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems engineering experience in a production environment. Deep hands-on TypeScript experience. We run TypeScript services on Bun, and we care about people who can design clean, reliable backend systems rather than only write application code. Strong understanding of queues, workers, retries, rate limits, idempotency, distributed locks, webhooks, and failure handling. Experience operating systems under real production pressure: incidents, provider outages, customer escalations, noisy alerts, slow dependencies, and incomplete data. Comfort with cloud-native infrastructure. Our stack includes GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, RabbitMQ, Redis, Postgres, Firestore, ClickHouse, Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry. Ability to debug across layers: application code, logs, metrics, queues, provider APIs, databases, network behaviour, and deployment state. Product-minded judgement. You can separate internal detail from customer-safe explanation, and you understand when a “small infra change” has customer, security, or cost implications. High ownership and low ego. We want people who take responsibility for ambiguous systems, ask sharp questions, and make the team better through clear thinking and kindness. A bias toward durable fixes. You do not stop at “restart the pod” if the real issue is retry amplification, missing backpressure, an unsafe parser assumption, or a provider limit we do not model. Tech stack Languages: TypeScript, Python Runtime/frameworks: Bun, Elysia, Node-compatible services Cloud/infrastructure: GCP, Kubernetes, Cloud Tasks, Pub/Sub, Firebase/Firestore, Postgres, ClickHouse, Redis, RabbitMQ Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, structured logging Product/data domain: LLM chats, AI search, source scraping, citation extraction, provider integrations, customer-facing analytics AI/model providers: OpenAI, Anthropic/Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, Google AI Mode / AI Overview, plus scraping/provider APIs around them What we offer Exciting and challenging work with real impact and ownership at one of Europe’s fastest-growing Series A startups Regular team events and off-sites Aggressive equity compensation package Paid

jobs.title: Senior Growth Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Wir bauen humanoide Systeme: Full Stack, von Hardware und Elektronik über Software bis zur Fertigung, alles in-house in Berlin. Bei Cell Labs verschieben wir die Grenze dessen, was Robotik leisten kann. Unser Ziel ist klar: Systeme bauen, die Menschen stärken statt sie zu ersetzen. Unsere Technologie ist bereits bei führenden Industriekunden und Partnern im Einsatz. Jetzt steht unser eigenes Produkt kurz vor dem Launch. Die leise Phase ist vorbei. Wir suchen Menschen, die früh dabei sein wollen, Verantwortung übernehmen und das bauen, worüber andere nur reden. Ort: Berlin · Start: Ab sofort · Arbeitsmodell: Vor Ort · Anstellung : Vollzeit Deine Aufgaben Marketingstrategie & Produktlaunch: Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Gründer:innen unsere Marketingstrategie und gestaltest den Launch unserer Produkte aktiv mit, von Messaging über Kampagnen bis zu Events. Partnerschaften & Kooperationen: Du identifizierst, verhandelst und steuerst Marketing-Kooperationen mit Technologiepartnern, Industriekunden und Hochschulen, von der ersten Ansprache bis zu gemeinsamen Projekten und Kampagnen. Go-to-Market: Du planst und steuerst Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Funnels. Über Website, SEO und Content baust du eine Inbound-Maschine, die qualifizierte Leads aus der Industrie bringt, und du unterstützt Outbound mit Zielkundenlisten und passenden Kampagnen. Events: Du entscheidest, welche Messen und Konferenzen für unser Wachstum zählen. Die Marketingseite von Industrieevents liegt bei dir, von Messaging und Lead-Erfassung über das Follow-up bis zu Speaking Slots für das Team. Markt & Wettbewerb: Du beobachtest den Robotik-, Automatisierungs- und Deep-Tech-Markt, erkennst Lücken in der Positionierung und bringst sie in Strategie und Produkt ein. Marketing-KPIs: Du definierst, misst und berichtest die Kennzahlen, die zählen: Pipeline-Beitrag, Conversion, Cost per Lead und Funnel-Entwicklung. Daraus leitest du Entscheidungen ab, statt nur Reports zu verwalten. Sales Enablement: In enger Abstimmung mit den Gründer:innen unterstützt du Vertrieb und Business Development mit Pitch-Material, Use Cases, Case Studies und Produktkommunikation für konkrete Verkaufssituationen. Investorenkommunikation: Du verfasst regelmäßige Investor-Updates und gestaltest die Storyline unseres Pitch Decks mit. Das bringst du mit Erfahrung: Du hast mindestens fünf Jahre im Marketing gearbeitet, davon einen Teil in einem Startup oder Scale-up, in dem du Marketing mit aufgebaut hast. Du hast mindestens einen größeren Produktlaunch begleitet und kannst erzählen, was funktioniert hat und was nicht. Neugier: Interesse an komplexen Technologien und die Motivation, tief in die Robotik einzutauchen, technische Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und verständlich zu vermitteln. Zahlen: Du setzt dir messbare Ziele und weißt, wie du sie nachhältst. Google Analytics, CRM-Software und A/B-Tests gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag, nicht in fremde Hände. Verhandlung auf Augenhöhe: Du bist sicher im Gespräch mit potenziellen Partnern und Kunden. Du findest heraus, was sie brauchen, und schätzt ein, ob ein Lead es wert ist, weiterverfolgt zu werden. Arbeitsweise: Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung und arbeitest gleichzeitig eng mit anderen zusammen. Du wechselst zwischen Strategie und Umsetzung, ohne eines von beidem aus dem Blick zu verlieren. Schreiben: Du schreibst gut und gerne selbst. Aus einem technischen Gespräch mit einem Engineer machst du eine Case Study oder Website-Copy, die Einkäufer:innen in der Industrie verstehen. Sprachen: Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher. Vorteile Marketing von Grund auf: Es gibt kein Playbook und keine Altlasten. Du gestaltest gemeinsam mit den Gründern, wie Cell Labs an den Markt geht, und siehst die Wirkung deiner Arbeit direkt in der Pipeline. Alles unter einem Dach: Büro, Werkstatt und Teststände liegen im selben Gebäude in Kreuzberg. Wenn du eine Story für eine Case Study brauchst oder den Roboter in Aktion sehen willst, ist der Engineer ein paar Schritte

jobs.title: Systemadministrator (m/w/d) - Microsoft 365 & Windows Server
jobs.description: Dein Einstieg bei Deeken Technology Du willst IT nicht nur betreiben, sondern Verantwortung übernehmen - für Systeme und für die Menschen, die damit arbeiten? Dann bist du bei uns richtig. Deeken Technology ist ein etabliertes IT-Systemhaus aus dem Oldenburger Münsterland - seit über 10 Jahren am Markt, mit einem motivierten und engagierten Team. Wir betreuen mittelständische Unternehmen ganzheitlich: IT-Infrastruktur, IT-Sicherheit, Digitalisierung und Telekommunikation. Dabei verkaufen wir keine Einmal-Lösungen, sondern sind langfristiger IT-Partner unserer Kunden - wir kennen ihre Systeme, ihre Abläufe und ihre Ansprechpartner. Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid. Deine Aufgaben Bei uns ist jeder Spezialist in seinem Fachgebiet - niemand muss alles können. Dein Schwerpunkt sind die Microsoft-Umgebungen unserer Kunden, vom Serverraum bis in die Cloud. - Du installierst, aktualisierst und betreust Domänencontroller sowie File- und Anwendungsserver - On-Premise und in Cloud-Umgebungen. - Du administrierst Microsoft 365, insbesondere Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune. - Du richtest Clients ein und erstellst dafür die passenden Intune-Richtlinien und Bereitstellungspläne. - Du installierst Fachanwendungen unserer Kunden wie ERP- oder Dokumentenmanagement-Systeme, begleitest Updates und stimmst dich dabei mit den Softwareherstellern ab. - Du bindest Kundeninfrastrukturen in unser Monitoring ein - damit wir Probleme erkennen, bevor unsere Kunden sie bemerken. - Du arbeitest eng mit deinen Kollegen aus den anderen Fachbereichen zusammen, erklärst technische Zusammenhänge verständlich und dokumentierst sauber in unserer Service-Plattform Hindeo. Das bringst du mit Fachwissen ist wichtig - Haltung entscheidet. Zwei Dinge sind uns deshalb bei jeder Einstellung besonders wichtig: Du kommunizierst klar und gern, mit Kunden genauso wie im Team. Und du übernimmst Verantwortung: Was du anfängst, bringst du zu Ende. - Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation - Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Administration von Windows Server und Active Directory, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus - Fundierte Praxis mit Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Entra ID und Intune - Wünschenswert: Virtualisierung (Proxmox), Netzwerkgrundlagen - Eine strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise und Freude an wechselnden Kundenumgebungen - Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie einen Führerschein der Klasse B Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander. Warum Deeken Technology - Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen inkl. Privatnutzung Firmenwagen zur Verfügung. - Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo. - Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein. - Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst. - Herstellerschulungen: Je nach Bedarf und Interesse absolvierst du Schulungen unserer Produktpartner, z. B. Hornetsecurity, WatchGuard, IONOS Cloud und CrowdStrike. - Neues Büro im ecopark: Knapp 500 m² im OM-Medienhaus - hell, klimatisiert, mit kontrollierter Belüftung, barrierefrei und mit Mensa im Haus. Getränke, Snacks und ein frischer Obstkorb stehen für dich bereit. - Ankommen ohne Stress: Kostenlose Parkplätze direkt am Haus. Für Elektrofahrzeuge stehen E-Ladesäulen bereit.
