jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.description: About Andercore Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry. Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell. We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought. We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded. Where we are today: Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth. About the role Andercore runs global trade end to end, from sourcing and pricing to sales, logistics and financing, and AI agents do a growing share of that work. Order values are high and prices and stock change daily, so the systems underneath have to be fast, correct and reliable at all times. As a Staff Engineer, you own our hardest technical problems and set the architecture across teams. You focus on what a fast-growing trading business cannot afford to get wrong: speed, reliability, security and observability. You report to our VP Engineering and work closely with our Senior Product Engineers, QA and product managers. You stay hands-on: you write code, review designs and raise the bar for everyone around you Tech stack Java 21 and Spring Boot 3, Python, LangGraph and LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini), PostgreSQL, Kinesis, AWS with Terraform, GitHub Actions, and TypeScript with Node.js, Next.js and React. Including Salesforce, which we are moving our transaction core out of. What you will do Set the technical direction across teams: define the target architecture, write the RFCs behind big decisions, and make sure teams build towards the same picture. Lead the hardest technical work yourself, from design to production, instead of only advising on it. Shape the carve-out of our transaction core from Salesforce into a modern, modular core system, with a migration path that never disrupts daily trading. Make reliability, security and observability part of how we build: monitoring, alerting, incident response and postmortems that lead to real changes. Design how our AI agents act safely on money-touching paths, with evaluations, guardrails, audit trails and human review where it matters. Set standards for correctness and data integrity, including idempotency, validation and testing, together with QA. Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing and direct feedback, and help us hire by defining what great engineering looks like at Andercore. In your first six month

jobs.description: <p></p> <p data-renderer-start-pos="36"><em><span data-contrast="auto"><strong>This position is fully remote/home based. Applications will be accepted from candidates based in the UK. This is a 2 Year FTC.</strong></span></em></p> <p></p> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p></p> <p>In this role you will oversee a subset of the growing PLOS journals portfolio: you will manage PLOS Biology and PLOS Medicine, with line-management of their professional Editors-in-Chief, and provide editorial oversight for a diverse set of journals led by academic volunteers across a range of disciplines in biology, human and environmental health. You will manage in line with PLOS strategy, helping to keep PLOS at the forefront of open science publishing and trusted content. You will leverage your strong relationships with the scientific community to drive engagement and develop the journals to meet the evolving needs of their global communities. You will work collaboratively with the journals’ Editorial Boards, and in-house colleagues, to create and deliver against journal strategies, using your international networks to grow PLOS’ profile and reputation.</p> <p>The role is an integral part of the senior PLOS editorial leadership. As such, you will be expected to engage PLOS Leaders’ Framework—adaptive decision-making, empowering others, iterative learning, agility, resilience, systems thinking, continuous improvement, catalysing opportunity—at an advanced level. As part of that leadership, you will also own ad hoc projects across the entire PLOS journals portfolio. Priority projects currently relate to quality control, workflow optimization, cost efficiency, non-article research outputs (data and code), policy development and community engagement. You will embrace change, and lead your teams effectively through it.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><em><strong>Journal portfolio management</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with the Directors of Editorial, Publishing, MarComms and Global Development to develop an editorial strategy for a portfolio of PLOS journals that supports PLOS’s commitments to Open Science, DEI, community engagement, trusted content and customer service</li> <li>Identify and develop opportunities to expand the portfolio in line with PLOS strategy</li> <li>Develop and oversee attainment of multi-term performance metrics for individual journals</li> <li>Partner with the Publishing Director to develop and manage annual budgets, ensuring responsible decision-making and efficient resource allocation to meet both budget and quality standards</li> <li>Work closely with Operations colleagues and vendors to oversee optimization of editorial workflows, systems and reporting</li> <li>Work closely with Marketing and Communications colleagues to ensure promotion of journal content and PLOS’ mission, and to drive journal submissions and uptake of Open Science practices</li> <li>Ensure that Editorial makes effective and efficient use of cross-journal Centers of Excellence (e.g. Publication Ethics, Editorial Board Services)</li> <li>Ensure that the portfolio shares cohesive and consistent editorial policies and quality standards, reacting dynamically to changing community needs while forefronting Open Science</li> <li>Lead cross-journal initiatives, overseeing development of systems and workflows</li> <li>Oversee Editorial participation in community initiatives, conferences and events, ensuring equality of opportunity and alignment with PLOS’ mission</li> <li>Help to ensure best-practice document hygiene and information sharing by everyone in Editoria

jobs.title: GTM Systems Lead
jobs.description: About Us We're Team Granola 👋 Granola is an AI-powered notepad for people in back-to-back meetings. What started as a better way to take notes has become a shared workspace that helps teams capture, organize, and act on what matters. We're building a product people genuinely love and are fortunate to work with many of the world's most ambitious companies. As we continue to grow, we're looking for a GTM Systems Lead to build the systems and data foundation that Sales, CS and leadership run on. About the Role We’re hiring a GTM Systems Lead to own the technology behind Granola’s commercial team as we scale. You’ll design, build and run the systems our Sales and CS teams rely on. Our current stack has served us well, but it needs to evolve as the team grows. You’ll take responsibility for how the tools fit together, what we build versus buy, and how information flows between them. This is a hands-on role. You’ll set the direction of the stack and implement the technical changes that make it work. You’ll work closely with Sales, CS and Data, and report to the Head of RevOps. You won’t be limited to administering a CRM or building isolated automations: you’ll own how the whole system works. What You’ll Do Design and evolve the GTM stack. Decide how our Sales and CS systems should fit together, what to build versus buy, and what to prioritise as we grow. Own the technical architecture of our CRM, Attio. Shape its data model, objects, workflows and integrations. You’ll be hands-on with configuration, particularly early on, but routine admin won’t be the sole focus of the role. Build and maintain integrations. Make data flow reliably across Attio and our wider toolset, including Apollo, Cal.com , Tally and Polytomic, and into the data systems used by the wider business. Own the wider toolset. Assess new tools and vendors, improve or replace what isn’t working, and make sure the stack is useful, reliable and cost-conscious. Find opportunities for automation and AI. Identify work that could be made easier for Sales and CS, and build or collaborate on solutions where they fit the priorities of the stack. Keep systems dependable. Troubleshoot problems, establish sensible governance and documentation, and partner with IT on access and security. Understand how teams work. Get close to Sales and CS workflows so the systems you build solve real problems, not just technical ones. What We’re Looking For Experience designing, building and owning systems used by a growing commercial team. Relevant hands-on experience matters more to us than a particular number of years or experience with a specific CRM. Sound judgement about system architecture, priorities and build-versus-buy decisions—and the ability to explain those decisions to non-technical colleagues. Technical depth beyond administering tools: you’ve built integrations and are comfortable working with APIs, webhooks and code. Experience with SQL, Python or JavaScript would be useful. An understanding of CRM data models, routing, enrichment and the operational work needed to keep data flowing reliably. A willingness to get into the weeds. You’re comfortable doing the implementation yourself while also thinking about how the stack should develop over time. Curiosity about AI-powered GTM workflows, with experience building them a plus rather than a prerequisite. A collaborative, low-ego approach. You can work through messy requests with Sales, CS and Data, challenge assumptions constructively, and ship solutions people can use. You don’t need to have used Attio or every tool in our stack. We’re more interested in what you’ve built, how you think about systems, and how you’d apply that experience here. About the Opportunity We are living in the most exciting time for tool builders since Engelbart's demo in 1968 and we want to assemble the best crew to build this future together. Our compensation philosophy is to hire the best people in the market and pay them accordingly with salary, variable,

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. The Samsara Application Security team protects this vast footprint end-to-end, spanning cloud services, internal systems, and firmware running on IoT hardware in the field. As a Staff Application Security Engineer, you'll drive the overarching technical direction for our application security and vulnerability management programs. This is a high-visibility role where you'll influence a broad surface area while retaining the flexibility to dive deep into critical domain focus areas as security priorities evolve. This is a remote position, open to candidates residing in the UK. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. You should apply if:  You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, and countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper-growth environment. You're energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers. You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best. Own and drive down mean time to remediate (MTTR) across the vulnerability backlog, as SLAs tighten. Build and champion automation and tooling that scale vulnerability detection and response across cloud, firmware/IoT, and corporate systems, rather than relying on manual, one-by-one review. Drive remediation by building trust with engineering teams and providing clear, actionable guidance — partnering with technical program management on reporting rather than owning it directly. jobs.description: At Jellyfish, we believe in the power of diverse perspectives and inclusive collaboration. We welcome individuals who excel in collaborative, varied teams and value the unique contributions that each person brings to the table. Jellyfish is a global digital marketing agency; a unique fusion of tech enthusiasts, creative minds, and media and data experts all united to empower our clients along their digital journey. Our commitment to embracing diverse perspectives fuels our innovation and strategies that challenge the status quo, reinvent media activation, and craft influential stories for our global clients and their customers. Join us in shaping a future where business growth and personal fulfilment go hand in hand. Job Description Reporting to the Experience Optimisation Director, you will play a key role in developing and implementing experience optimisation and conversion rate optimisation (CRO) strategies for a French multinational holding company specialising in luxury goods. We take pride in delivering data-led experimentation, personalisation, and deep analytical insights for premier global brands, setting us apart in the industry. At Jellyfish, we are committed to fostering professional growth. Your career path could lead to progression into a CRO Senior Manager position with future potential to lead the practice. This is a hybrid position, based out of our Paris office. The gross annual salary range for this position is between EUR 38,000-42,000, and the final offer is dependent on experience. Responsibilities Lead client meetings with a key luxury account to translate their business needs into strategic optimisation roadmaps aligned with their goals, driving measurable value and high client satisfaction. Be the subject matter expert in conversion rate optimisation (CRO), experience optimisation, measurement, and marketing analytics across the client's brands. Execute full-lifecycle user journey audits, research, continuous experimentation, and cross-channel activation campaigns to deliver actionable insights. Define custom reporting and data-mapping requirements, collaborating cross-functionally to align technical solutions and timelines with strategic rationale. Provide mentorship and escalation support for junior team members to foster professional growth and resolve operational challenges. Qualifications Fluency in French and professional-level English is required given the scope of work and the client teams. Over 2 years of experience in end-to-end experience optimisation or CRO, including defining, launching, and evaluating A/B and Multivariate Testing (MVT) Campaigns using A/B testing platforms or website optimisation tools. The ability to analyse user behaviour and map customer journeys from initial discovery to final measurement, ideally within the luxury, beauty or fashion industries. Proficiency in web, app and product analytics combined with qualitative research tools (heatmapping, form analytics, live user testing) to uncover user behaviour insights. Analytical and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate complex quantitative and qualitative data into actionable findings, recommendations, and optimisation roadmaps. You love getting to know your clients, developing long-lasting relationships and adding value to their business. When faced with a problem, you collaborate with the appropriate people to evaluate different options find practical solutions. Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English. Additional Information Join Jellyfish and experience a workplace where we prioritise your growth, celebrate your contributions, and empower you to tailor your work environment to suit your needs. 💰 Reward: You'll be eligible to join our discretionary annual bonus scheme. 💫 Custom Work Environment: Work remotely for up to 60% of your days

jobs.title: Senior Optical Systems Engineer
jobs.description: About Quandela: Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges. Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions About this position:  You will join the QPU Prototyping team , which develops and integrates the optical systems at the heart of Quandela's quantum processors, turning advanced R&D experiments into operational hardware.  We are looking for a Senior Optical Systems Engineer to take ownership of a major optical development work package within our next-generation QPU programme.  Your main challenge will be to maximise optical transmission and system performance , from experimental characterisation and precision alignment to qualification and integration. You'll tackle complex optical challenges, defining the right experimental approaches and driving solutions from investigation to validation.  You will also coordinate technical activities involving several engineers and scientists, ensuring the delivery of critical milestones.  This is a predominantly hands-on experimental role , combining deep technical expertise with project ownership. Requirements What you'll do:  Develop and optimise optical systems  Design, assemble, align and operate complex optical setups.  Characterise optical transmission, identify losses and improve efficiency.  Define measurement methods and improve stability and reproducibility.  Troubleshoot experimental challenges and implement reliable solutions.  Qualify and integrate optical subsystems  Optimise research-developed optical subsystems for QPU integration.  Define experimental tests, performance targets and qualification procedures.  Collaborate with optics, electronics and system integration teams.  Drive technical delivery  Own technical deliverables within a major optical development project.  Coordinate experimental activities across engineers and scientists.  Plan tasks, milestones, equipment and laboratory resources.  Anticipate technical risks, resolve blockers and guide contributors.  The role combines approximately 80% hands-on experimental work and 20% technical coordination , with no initial requirement for formal people management.  - How you'll grow:  First 3 months: Become familiar with Quandela's optical systems, experimental infrastructure and qualification objectives.  Within 6 months: Take ownership of optical characterisation and optimisation activities, coordinating experimental work and technical milestones.  Within 12 months: Lead the technical delivery of complex optical developments, with increasing autonomy over planning and resources.  Longer term : Potential progression towards technical team leadership as the team grows.  - Requirements  What we're looking for:  We are looking for an experienced optical engineer or experimental scientist with strong hands-on expertise and the ability to drive complex technical projects.  Relevant backgrounds include fibered optical systems, laser systems, experimental optics, and optical metrology. Academic and industrial experience are equally welcome.  Must-have:  PhD in Optics, Photonics, Physics or related fields.  >5 years of experimen

jobs.description: EggAI · Banking transformation programme (UK) · Remote, UK-facing — London for gate weeks About the Programme EggAI is the transformation partner on a core banking system replacement for a client to lay the foundations of operating Agentic Generative AI in production. EggAI's role is to specify, set the standard and programme-manage. You will define what operational readiness means and prove it at each gate, working with the client's own teams and its managed service providers, as well as EggAI's platform engineers. The platform is a mix of classical banking infrastructure and agentic AI workloads, so the reliability problem runs across both deterministic and probabilistic systems. The Role Own the definition of operational readiness for go-live: what "ready to run in production" means, how the bank proves it at each regulatory gate, and what has to change in the organisation for that proof to hold. The bank's operations teams, processes and provider contracts were built to run classical banking infrastructure. Agentic AI workloads need a different operating model, and you will shape it: redraw responsibilities between the client's teams and its managed service providers, set the standards each party works to, and lead the people through the change — so that those who run the platform today are ready and willing to run what comes next. This is a lead/principal position reporting to the Programme Plan and Execution Lead. It is remote, with regular London presence required for gate weeks and workshops. Responsibilities Reliability targets — set the SLO and error-budget framework alongside the client's existing structure, have the service owners adopt it, and commission the behavioural quality measures that do the same job for agentic workloads Observability and detection — define what Tier-1 services and agentic workloads must emit, including trajectory logging; require an automated path from a firing alert to the affected services and their owners; and hold the operating teams to closing the logging gaps in what runs today The incident and change path — set the runbook standard and its required coverage, extend incident classification and intervention mechanisms to agentic failure modes, and have rollback and change-failure rates measured and reported by those who own them Capacity and performance — direct the headroom position through the parallel-run peak at cutover, sponsor the chaos and game-day programme for payment rails and the core ledger, and mandate that capacity modelling covers inference workloads Gate evidence — own the technical content of the Operational Acceptance Report and Operational Readiness Certificate, the reliability section of each gate pack, and the reliability NFRs defended as ADRs through the client's Architecture Design Authority — written by the teams, reviewed and signed off by you The operating organisation — decide how jobs.description: CDI · Paris · Mission en régie chez HBO · Prise de poste dès que possible Odace recrute un(e) Chargé(e) de projets Social Media pour une mission en régie au sein des équipes HBO. Vous rejoignez Odace et travaillez au quotidien chez notre client pour concevoir et coordonner ses campagnes social media en France, autour des séries, films et temps forts de la plateforme. Nous recherchons une personne rapidement opérationnelle, à l’aise avec la création de contenus, la coordination de production et les échanges avec plusieurs interlocuteurs. Une disponibilité immédiate ou à court terme est appréciée : précisez votre première date de disponibilité dans votre candidature. À propos d’Odace Odace est une Maison de création qui accompagne les marques et les institutions dans leurs stratégies de contenu et leurs productions social media. Nous réunissons conseil éditorial, création et production pour imaginer des contenus adaptés aux usages des plateformes. Vos missions Piloter les projets social media : organiser les étapes de production, du brief à la livraison, suivre les plannings et les validations, et garantir la qualité des contenus ainsi que le respect des délais. Imaginer les campagnes et rédiger les contenus : proposer des concepts créatifs autour des titres et temps forts HBO, rédiger les publications et adapter le ton aux plateformes et aux publics. Adapter les contenus au marché français : décliner les éléments internationaux en contenus pertinents pour les audiences locales, dans le respect de l’identité de marque et des consignes éditoriales. Coordonner les équipes et les agences : centraliser les besoins, préparer les briefs, suivre les livrables et faciliter les échanges entre marketing, création, production et partenaires externes. Accompagner les activations et les productions : participer à la préparation des avant-premières, tournages et dispositifs avec des créateurs de contenu ; coordonner les captations et les collaborations avec les partenaires et influenceurs. Suivre les performances et nourrir les recommandations : analyser les résultats des campagnes, préparer les bilans et assurer une veille sur les formats, les usages et les tendances du divertissement. Votre profil Une expérience solide en gestion de projets social media, en agence ou chez l’annonceur, avec la capacité de prendre en main plusieurs sujets en parallèle. Une excellente qualité rédactionnelle en français et un anglais professionnel, à l’écrit comme à l’oral, pour échanger avec les équipes et adapter les contenus internationaux. Une bonne connaissance des plateformes sociales, de leurs codes éditoriaux et des outils de publication et d’analyse. De la rigueur dans le suivi des plannings, des briefs et des validations, ainsi qu’un bon sens des priorités. De l’autonomie, de la réactivité et une communication claire avec les équipes du client, les agences et les partenaires. Un intérêt marqué pour les séries, le cinéma, la création audiovisuelle et la culture des communautés en ligne. Le cadre du poste Employeur : Odace. Mission : en régie chez HBO Max, à Paris. Contrat : CDI. Rémunération à préciser lors des échanges. Démarrage : dès que possible, selon votre disponibilité. Avantages Odace : mutuelle prise en charge à 100 %, titres-restaurant et prise en charge des frais de déplacement selon les modalités applicables. Rejoignez un projet innovant à l’intersection de l’intelligence artificielle, de la vidéo et de l’Activité Physique Adaptée My GOOD LIFE développe des solutions et des contenus visant à promouvoir l’Activité Physique Adaptée auprès de différents publics, notamment les personnes souhaitant reprendre une activité physique, préserver leur autonomie ou améliorer leur qualité de vie. Dans le cadre de son développement, My GOOD LIFE souhaite intégrer l’intelligence artificielle générative à la conception de supports vidéo pédagogiques, accessibles et adaptés aux besoins des différents publics. Dans ce contexte, nous recrutons notre futur(e) : Stagiaire en intelligence artificielle générative et création de contenus vidéo APA (H/F) Votre mission Encadré(e) par notre équipe, vous participez à la conception et à la production de vidéos d’Activité Physique Adaptée grâce aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative. Votre mission consiste à expérimenter différents outils, concevoir et optimiser des prompts, générer des contenus vidéo et contribuer à l’amélioration continue de leur qualité pédagogique et visuelle. À la fois créatif(ve), rigoureux(se) et curieux(se), vous participez à la construction d’une méthodologie permettant de produire des contenus cohérents, réalistes, accessibles et adaptés aux objectifs de l’Activité Physique Adaptée. Vos principales responsabilités Vous intervenez notamment sur les volets suivants : Concevoir, tester et optimiser des prompts destinés aux outils d’intelligence artificielle générative. Générer des vidéos illustrant des mouvements, exercices et séances d’Activité Physique Adaptée. Tester et comparer différentes solutions de génération vidéo, d’animation, d’avatars et, si nécessaire, de voix off. Améliorer la fluidité des mouvements, la posture, la cohérence visuelle et la clarté des consignes proposées. Participer à la création de contenus pédagogiques adaptés à différents publics et niveaux de pratique. Analyser les résultats obtenus et faire évoluer les prompts afin d’améliorer progressivement la qualité des productions. Formaliser une méthodologie de production en documentant les prompts utilisés, les outils mobilisés, les résultats obtenus et les bonnes pratiques. Le profil que nous recherchons Vous préparez une formation dans l’un des domaines suivants : intelligence artificielle, informatique, audiovisuel, multimédia, design numérique, création de contenus digitaux ou ingénierie pédagogique. Vous êtes particulièrement intéressé(e) par les usages concrets de l’intelligence artificielle générative et souhaitez participer à un projet associant technologie, mouvement, sport et santé. Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour : Votre capacité à rédiger des instructions précises et structurées ; Votre intérêt pour les outils d’IA générative et de création vidéo ; Votre capacité à expérimenter, comparer et améliorer les résultats obtenus ; Votre sens de l’image, de la pédagogie et du détail ; Votre autonomie, votre créativité et votre rigueur ; Votre esprit d’initiative et votre curiosité. Une première expérience avec des outils de génération vidéo par IA, de création d’avatars ou de montage vidéo constitue un véritable atout. Une connaissance du domaine sportif, de la santé ou de l’Activité Physique Adaptée sera également appréciée. Pourquoi rejoindre My GOOD LIFE ? Vous rejoignez un projet innovant qui associe intelligence artificielle, création de contenus vidéo et Activité Physique Adaptée. Ce stage vous permettra d’expérimenter concrètement les nouveaux outils de génération vidéo, de développer vos compétences en prompt engineering et de participer à la création de contenus ayant une finalité pédagogique et d’utilité sociale. Vous évoluerez dans un environnement favorisant l’expérimentation, la créativité, l’autonomie et l’acquisition de nouvelles compétences techniques. jobs.description: ENSTA, établissement d’enseignement supérieur et de recherche sous tutelle du ministère des Armées, développe des activités de formation, de recherche et d’innovation dans les domaines de la défense et de la sécurité, des transports, de l'énergie, des activités maritimes, du numérique et de la santé. L’école, présente sur deux campus, à Paris-Saclay et à Brest, est membre de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris. Classée dans le Top 10 des meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France, elle a pour mission : la formation d’élèves ingénieurs civils et militaires, de cadres et docteurs pour les secteurs public et privé, la recherche et l’innovation de haut niveau en relation étroite avec l’industrie des grands secteurs de souveraineté au sein de 6 unités de formation et de recherche (UFR).        Le/la titulaire du poste sera affecté au sein de l’Unité de Formation et de Recherche (UFR) Mécanique. L’UFR de Mécanique a pour mission d’assurer la formation en mécanique des élèves du cursus ingénieur d’ENSTA, des élèves de masters de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, et la formation par la recherche d’étudiants français et étrangers au niveau master et doctorat. L’Unité développe également des activités de recherche dans le domaine de la mécanique des matériaux et des structures, de la mécanique des fluides, des vibrations et de l’acoustique. Ces activités sont réalisées grâce à un important parc expérimental de haut niveau en mécanique des solides et des fluides, tant pour l’enseignement que la recherche. Le projet vise à développer un robot autonome capable d’intervenir en continu sur les coques de navires pour les nettoyer et limiter l’apparition d’algues et coquillages afin de réduire sa consommation énergétique et ses émissions de C02. Les modèles développés seront également confrontés à des essais de validation dans la nouvelle veine aérodynamique de l’école. La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les enseignants-chercheurs de l’ENSTA, pôle thématique de recherche « Structure Interaction Fluide (StIF) » de l’IRDL.   Le recrutement s’inscrit dans le projet MULTIRIM, qui vise à développer des solutions innovantes en propulsion marine. Les propulseurs marins à entraînement circonférentiel constituent une alternative aux hélices classiques marines, en présentant plusieurs avantages : manoeuvrabilité, compacité, discrétion acoustique, amélioration de la traînée de la carène par l’absence de ligne d’arbre. Cependant, la présence d’une tuyère embarquant le moteur électrique d’entraînement pénalise le rendement. Une piste d’amélioration est d’adopter un propulseur à plusieurs étages à l’instar des moteurs d’avion, afin de regagner environ vingt points de rendement. La configuration même de l’entraînement extérieur, sans arbre, supprime la complexité mécanique rencontrée sur les hélices contrarotatives classiques. Or, il existe très peu de bancs d’essai pour les propulseurs à entraînement circonférentiel, pour une seule hélice, ainsi que très peu de données expérimentales de référence. Les difficultés sont de deux ordres. Du point de vue fonctionnement, le refroidissement du moteur électrique nécessite des échanges thermiques, et la liaison rotor/stator est assurée par un palier hydrodynamique. La mise ne eau dans une veine hydrodynamique est ainsi obligatoire. Par ailleurs, l’absence d’arbre d’entraînement empêche une mesure aisée du couple d’entraînement, valeur requise pour déterminer le rendement global du propulseur. Intégrer plusieurs étages propulsifs au sein d’un même propulseur au sein d’un banc d’essai expérimental n’a jamais été proposé au niveau international. Cependant, le mode de fonctionnement de l’entraînement circonférentiel le permet aisément. Disposer de résultats expérimentaux de référence, tant pour les efforts globaux que pour l’écoulement (champ de vitesse, de pression) présente un intérêt fort pour la communauté scientifique. You'll work across the whole customer lifecycle, from first demo through renewal, with regular visits to customer offices and job sites across the region. with shared revenue targets Native German and business-fluent English, spoken and written Ability to travel regularly to customer offices and job sites across DACH A solid understanding of how jobs.title: ICT System Engineer & Developer 80-100 %
jobs.description: Du liebst die Abwechslung und willst Dich nicht zwischen Systembetrieb und Softwareentwicklung entscheiden müssen? Bei uns kannst Du beides! Wir suchen eine strukturierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere IT-Infrastruktur im Griff hat und gleichzeitig neue Softwarelösungen mitgestaltet. Wir wachsen und verstärken deshalb unser vierköpfiges ICT-Team per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung mit einem neuen Teammitglied im Pensum von 80 bis 100 %. Gemeinsam betreuen wir die IT unserer Firmengruppe mit mehreren Mandanten, mit über 100 Benutzerinnen und Benutzern an mehreren Standorten. Ob Dein Fundament in der Systemtechnik oder in der Applikationsentwicklung liegt: Wenn Du für moderne Technologien brennst, wollen wir Dich im Team haben. Aufgaben ICT Operation & Netzwerke Du stellst den stabilen Betrieb der IT-Umgebungen unserer gesamten Firmengruppe sicher, insbesondere Windows Server und Clients, Virtualisierung sowie Managed Security Services. Du betreust unsere Microsoft SQL Server und die dazugehörigen Datenbanken und sorgst für deren Verfügbarkeit und Performance. Du betreust unser internes Netzwerk, überwachst es aktiv und schützt unsere Netzwerkinfrastruktur mit geeigneten Tools und Firewalls. Du überwachst den operativen Betrieb proaktiv mit modernen Monitoring-Tools und behebst Störungen frühzeitig. Du verwaltest selbstständig die Benutzerberechtigungen im Active Directory und in Microsoft 365 und betreust gemeinsam mit unserem Partner unsere 3CX-Telefonielösung. Software & Innovation Du unterstützt das Team bei der Entwicklung, Implementierung und Wartung unserer internen Applikationen und Schnittstellen. Du nimmst Anforderungen aus den Fachabteilungen auf und setzt sie in pragmatische technische Lösungen um. Du testest moderne KI-Tools und integrierst sie, um interne Prozesse einfacher und effizienter zu gestalten. Support & Teamwork Du arbeitest im First- und Second-Level-Support mit und beantwortest die Fragen unserer Mitarbeitenden kompetent und hilfsbereit. Qualifikation Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Informatikerin oder Informatiker EFZ mit Schwerpunkt Systemtechnik oder Applikationsentwicklung oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit fundierter Berufserfahrung. Fundierte Erfahrung im Betrieb von Windows Server- und Client-Umgebungen. Kenntnisse in Proxmox VE (PVE) sind ein Plus. Ein gutes Grundverständnis für Netzwerke und Firewalls sowie ein ausgeprägtes Sicherheitsbewusstsein. Erste Erfahrungen in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# im .NET-Umfeld und JavaScript sowie Freude daran, dieses Wissen zu vertiefen. Routine mit PowerShell oder anderen Skriptsprachen, um Aufgaben und administrative Prozesse zu automatisieren. Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise. Du packst Aufgaben proaktiv an. Grosses Interesse an neuen Technologien und Lust, das Potenzial von KI-Tools im Arbeitsalltag auszuloten. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Englischkenntnisse zum Verstehen von Fachliteratur und Dokumentationen. Benefits Eine abwechslungsreiche Generalistenrolle mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum in einem wachsenden Unternehmen. Ein kleines, kollegiales Team mit kurzen Wegen und schnellen Entscheiden. Eine pragmatische Kultur, in der neugierige Ideen willkommen sind und KI-Tools aktiv eingesetzt werden. 5 Wochen Ferien. Jedes dritte Jahr eine zusätzliche Ferienwoche oder deren Auszahlung. Zeiterfassung mit der Möglichkeit, Überstunden zu kompensieren oder auszahlen zu lassen. Die Möglichkeit für Homeoffice. Interessiert? Dann freuen wir uns auf Deine Bewerbung! jobs.title: Robot Pilot
jobs.description: About nu glass The Robot Pilot is responsible for operating our laser robot technology on-site, ensuring strict adherence to production schedules, quality standards, and safety guidelines. What we are looking for We are looking for someone ready to take on the operation of our specialized laser ablation equipment within our agile team. Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting. jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager - Paid Social (m/f/d)
jobs.description: About Hilo by Aktiia High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.  We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.  We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation. Applicants must already hold a valid visa or work permit for their country of residence, as Hilo is not able to provide visa sponsorship. Role overview As Performance Marketing Manager – Paid Social , you will own Hilo’s paid social strategy and performance across our key markets and prepare the channel for Hilo’s next stage of growth. Creative strategy is a core driver of paid social performance: You turn customer insight and campaign data into compelling concepts, run a rigorous testing program and work with creative partners to bring the strongest ideas to market. jobs.title: AI Engineer (Agentic AI)
jobs.description: Legal AI is only as good as the knowledge behind it. At Lefebvre Sdu, we’ve been building that knowledge for 200 years. Day in, day out. Law by law. Word by word. Other legal AI tools run on our data and software. As the Dutch heart of Lefebvre Group, the European leader in legal and tax knowledge, we’re also developing our own platform: GenIA-L, where lawyers and tax professionals don’t just get an answer, but an answer they’re willing to put their name to. More than 75,000 professionals use it every day, accounting for over €100 million ARR across Europe. We’re looking for a Medior AI Engineer to help shape how the intelligent core of that platform evolves. HOW YOU'LL MOVE US FORWARD GenIA-L is a research platform for legal professionals. A user asks a question. The platform searches our trusted sources and turns them into a useful answer. It does this with agents: specialised AI components that each handle part of the question and work together. In the legal domain, an answer can't just sound fluent. It has to be correct, and you must be able to see which source it comes from. This is not a pilot project: the platform runs in production and is used heavily every day. As a medior, your focus is on building. You work independently, on challenges that come from customers and on challenges we spot ourselves. You break down a legal process, translate it into a technical process and work out how to best connect the pieces. Stuck on something? You say so, and your colleagues think along with you. You build and improve the agents of GenIA-L and the way they work together. You build and maintain our knowledge packages: for each legal article, an expert-validated set of commentary, case law, parliamentary history and practical interpretation. You also work on the pipelines that create these packages and keep them up to date. You make quality measurable. With evaluation sets, observability and metrics, you show that answers, source attribution and reliability really improve. Not by gut feeling, but with evidence. You build features for customers, such as analysing their own documents and new ways to search case law. You work directly with editors and subject-matter experts, and check with them which parts of a legal question really matter. You come up with and test ideas to make the product sharper or faster, and alternate AI experiments with back-end development. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR You have a realistic view of LLMs. You see what they can do, but you also know their weak spots. You enjoy following new AI developments, but you don't just follow the herd: you stay critical. You think in a structured way and can break a complex problem into smaller pieces. You work independently, take initiative when things are unclear and are eager to learn fast. And you enjoy working with lawyers and editors, because they know what a good answer looks like. You have several years of experience in software or ML engineering. Depth in recent projects counts for more than years. Strong experience in agentic AI. You have good knowledge of Python and experience with relevant machine learning libraries. You have helped build an LLM application that runs in production. Not just prototypes, notebooks or courses. You have hands-on experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain, tool calling, MCP or comparable orchestration. Our entire product is built around this. Experience with only a simple search-and-answer (RAG) setup is not enough. You have measured the quality of an LLM system with evaluation sets or observability, and can give a concrete example. Experience with tools like MLflow and LiteLLM is a plus. You have back-end experience, including building REST APIs. You have experience in Kubernetes. Experience with Postgres is useful. Experience in a legal, tax or other knowledge-intensive domain is a plus. WHAT YOU'RE SIGNING UP FOR On Tuesdays and Thursdays, the team works together at the office. Our mission We turn data into better healthcare. With our insights, we make healthcare more affordable and better, and we improve the patients' and clinicians' experience. Your impact Dutch clinical registries are among the richest sources of outcome data in Europe. At LOGEX, that data reaches clinicians and hospitals through applications such as Codman and Data Entry, and reaches researchers and healthcare professionals through data requests and exports. As Senior Product Owner you own that portfolio end to end: the applications that clinicians use every day, and the data pipelines that power them. You are the product owner for our largest registry partner and decide what gets built within a fixed capacity. You also make sure that what we build strengthens the wider LOGEX platform wherever possible. What you'll own Applications: user-facing applications for manual data entry, dashboarding and exports – owning the roadmap, priorities and release quality. Pipelines and business logic: registry processing (merge, load, curation), data exports, scientific data requests, data linkage and registry development sets. One backlog, two types of developers: you lead the product work of a team that combines data engineers with back-end and front-end developers. You translate user and partner’s needs into work for both, and you see early where a front-end change depends on a pipeline change. Prioritisation within fixed capacity: you align with one counterpart at our largest registry partner on what gets built and when, with transparent trade-offs, realistic yearly planning and a clear path to extra capacity when it is funded. jobs.title: International Expansion
jobs.description: About Us At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, inverters and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . We’re looking for a commercially sharp, highly autonomous operator to drive Axle’s commercial success in the Dutch market. Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we’re now looking to expand our reach internationally. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for energy flexibility globally, and we’re hiring the person to make that happen. This role will assess Axle’s participation in Dutch markets and business models from first principles: diving deep into regulations, modelling revenue-per-asset, and trialling new propositions at pace. You speak Dutch and fluent English. Other European languages will also be an asset. What you will be doing Owning new customer acquisition end-to-end, from first conversation through to commercial close, setting our partners up to generate meaningful revenue. High-level strategy development, defining and executing Axle’s international expansion plans, and assessing the commercial value of Dutch markets and business models. Diving deep into policy and regulations, understanding how market access works and what needs doing to achieve it. Developing the zero-to-one of the business through partnerships with key stakeholders. You’ll be jumping on the phone (and eventually, getting on the ground) with grid operators, utilities/retailers and potential clients to create and disprove hypotheses as quickly as possible. Acting as a conduit between partners and engineering teams creating fast, structured feedback loops that help translate field insights into meaningful product enhancements. As such, we are looking for a “full-stack operator” who can process highly technical information, ramp up commercial value, and accelerate us into new markets. You might have previous experience in one or more of the activities above, but we are more interested in your growth potential than your domain-specific expertise. We are looking for people who have built things, developed new relationships, and helped get big projects over the line in complex environments. This is an opportunity to repeatedly deliver first-of-a-kind projects across the world, become a domain expert, and work at the bleeding edge of global electrification. What’s in it for you This is a 12 month fixed-term contract. Compensation is highly competitive and dependent on experience. We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation. Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose. You’ll be based in the Netherlands. To maximise collaboration, we ask that you spend ~1 week per month working from our London office. The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world. We are extremely keen to build a diverse team, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’. Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business! Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten: De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen; Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews); Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling; Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol  Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijntjes te kleuren, initiatief te nemen en daardoor dus graag aan de slag gaat met nieuwe inzichten en projecten. Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig en ben je van nature erg nieuwsgierig. Wat wij van jou verwachten: Je bent een Bachelor student in de richting Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of soortgelijk; Je bent beschikbaar voor een stageduur van een half jaar (startende in februari); Je hebt de gedrevenheid om een complexe uitdaging, zoals het meetbaar maken van R&D, aan te vliegen. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Binnen deze rol krijg je de vrijheid en kans om een cruciale rol te spelen in het succes van een organisatie met enorme internationale marktpotentie. Je maakt deel uit van een stimulerende en internationale werkomgeving, waarin je kunt samenwerken met getalenteerde en ambitieuze professionals en de ruimte krijgt om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Uiteraard belonen we je inzet met een mooie stagevergoeding en uitstekende secundaire voorwaarden, zoals: Een goede stagevergoeding; Thuiswerkmogelijkheden; De kans om de werkelijke impact van autonomie, een doel (purpose) en groei te ervaren; Een flexibele en relaxte werkomgeving. Are you interested in bridging the gap between highly specialized engineering disciplines to deliver next-generation autonomous solutions? Do you want to play a key role in developing next-generation solutions for partners recognized as international leaders in clean and autonomous mobility? If so, we want you on our team as our new Senior Project Manager! Who we are We are a fast-growing high-tech company with a clear mission: accelerating the transition to sustainable mobility through hands-free charging technology. By combining soft robotics, computer vision, and software, we build reliable solutions that make fleet electrification easier and more scalable. We are a global organization, headquartered in Rijswijk, the Netherlands, with a U.S. office in Portland, OR. Together, we are building a cleaner future. You make the difference As a Senior Project Manager at Rocsys, you will direct the execution of technically complex product development projects from concept to deployment. You will serve as the central connector between Product Management, Product Development (R&D), Supply Chain, and Customer Success. What makes this role impactful is your ability to coordinate complex project delivery across two distinct axes: Multidisciplinary R&D Execution: You synchronize highly diverse engineering tracks—including hardware, electronics, embedded/cloud software, computer vision, AI, and robotics—to ensure integrated system delivery. Cross-Departmental Alignment: Rather than defining requirements or architecture, you own the execution bridge. You translate Product Management’s strategic roadmap into R&D milestones, and manage the operational handover to Manufacturing, Sourcing, and Service. Your core focus remains on tracking the critical path, keeping timelines rigid, and safeguarding quality and cost boundaries. In this role you will Drive Multidisciplinary Engineering Execution Collaborate closely with and align engineers across a wide variety of technical disciplines: system engineering, hardware design, electronics, embedded software, cloud applications, computer vision, AI, and robotics. Manage End-to-End NPI Projects Lead complex product development cycles. Relentlessly manage project schedules, proactively tracking dependencies and safeguarding the critical path and scope. Support Cross-Functional Collaboration Establish transparent communication loops between R&D teams and internal business pillars (Supply Chain, Production, Field Service, and Procurement). Communicating technical engineering status updates for high-level strategic alignment with product management and executives. What you will bring into Rocsys Your knowledge and experience :  A completed Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in a highly technical field or Business Administration with an affinity with deep-tech. A minimum of 5 years of proven experience as a project manager within a high-tech, complex product development or R&D environment. Demonstrated track record of successfully delivering complex hardware-software integrated products. A technical foundation allowing you to think critically at a systems level and engage constructively with domain experts across technical disciplines. Clear and concise communication skills. Willing to travel occasionally to support key validation or deployment phases. Experience working within an international technical organization. What we offer A 32–40 hour work week Hybrid working model with flexible hours Salary range between € 7.500 and € 10.500 gross monthly Employee stock option plan 25 vacation days, with the option to purchase 5 additional days Bicycle plan Strong career development opportunities as we scale A dynamic and collaborative company culture Free daily vegetarian lunch Wednesday afternoon drinks Easily accessible office in Rijswijk *This role is based in the Ne

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Data Engineer Shiftbase is building the self-driving assistant for shift-based businesses across Europe. Our customers range from independent restaurants in Amsterdam to multi-location retailers in München, and they spend hours every week on scheduling, time tracking, payroll prep, and HR admin. We want to take that work off their plate and eventually do it for them. Underneath that product vision sits a data challenge. Insight, automation, and AI all depend on data people can trust, and the foundation for it doesn't exist yet. You will build the foundation that fixes this. What you'll do Architect the warehouse. Design and own our BigQuery and Dataform warehouse from the ground up. Build a layered, well-modeled foundation, medallion staging through marts, not only the models that sit on top. Ask every day whether the whole company can trust and reuse it. Make the data flow reliably. Build ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads, orchestration, and retries, so pipelines run on time without anyone watching them. Ship monitored pipelines that hold up in production. Take the transform layer. Own the Dataform model-building and transform layer, taking full responsibility for the transformation layer and freeing up capacity for semantic modeling and business definitions. This unblocks the whole team. Build trust into the data. Make validation, freshness monitoring, alerting, and lineage the default. Diagnose failures at the root cause. leadscorev2 is the outcome this role exists to prevent. Serve the whole company. Feed clean, governed datasets to Metabase, HubSpot, and the ML and AI work the product ML team owns. Push modeled data back into the tools business teams act on, including HubSpot and Customer.io . Own the Platform handshake. Run the day-to-day collaboration with the Platform team on our GCP foundation, a bridge that only gets part-time attention today. Treat the warehouse like a product. Keep documentation, lineage, and discoverability current so departments trust the data assets, and handle sensitive HR and workforce data to GDPR standards. What success looks like in your first 3–6 months The warehouse has a real foundation. The first vertical slice, our accounts model, ships with tests and monitoring. You fully own the Dataform transform layer, creating capacity for semantic modeling and business-definition work Pipelines run against a defined freshness SLA, and you catch breaks before stakeholders do. Documentation and lineage cover what you own, and datasets that were stuck now flow to the teams that need them. What we're looking for You have built warehouse foundations yourself. You designed them rather than maintaining someone else's, with a track record in: Designing layered warehouse architectures (medallion, bronze-silver-gold) and dimensional models (star and snowflake) that teams reuse Advanced SQL as your daily working language Hands-on BigQuery, since our stack is GCP Building a SQL transform layer in Dataform, or strong dbt experience. ELT and ETL with incremental, idempotent loads and real orchestration, scheduling, and dependency management Data quality, testing, freshness monitoring, and lineage built in from the start Python for pipeline code, scripting, automation, and API integration Reviewable, repeatable change through Git and PR-based deployment Nice to have, not required: another modern cloud warehouse such as Snowflake or Redshift; managed ingestion such as Airbyte; preparing data for ML, LLM, and agentic use cases; and familiarity with B2B SaaS metrics and HR or workforce data. English is our working language, and Dutch is not required. This role isn't infrastructure engineering, ML or MLOps, or dashboard analysis. The Platform team owns infrastructure, the Product ML team owns ML, and the business teams own dashboards. It also isn't for someone who has only maintained a warehouse another person designed. You build the foundation properly, stay transparent about data quality and trade-of

The culture is open and informal. You can push back on an idea regardless of title, and we change how we work when someone makes the case in retro. About the role You build frontend features that customers use the day you release them. You sit in a product team with backend, QA, design and product, and you take a feature from a rough product idea to a screen a planner can use without a manual. Your time is a balance between working on features, bugs and resolving technical debt. Claude Code is how our engineers write software. Everyone here uses it daily, and whole features now go out with an agent doing most of the coding. You still own what you merge, so you read the diff, you know why it works, and you can defend it in review. The interesting part of the job is deciding what to hand to an agent, what to write yourself, and what context the agent needs to get it right the first time. You ask what a planner is trying to do before you read what the ticket says. You automate the parts of your own process that don't need a human. Year one, in order First, ship. Deliver features in scheduling and time tracking. Start small, then take one full feature from the product conversation through to release. Then, own an area. Pick up a product surface end to end and become the person the team asks about it, including what it should do next. That covers how AI fits your area, which patterns you document for the agent and which calls you keep for yourself. Along the way, make what you build safe to change. Restructure and test the paths you build on while you build on them. Extend test coverage where it's lacking. We move fast and keep quality up by automating what a human doesn't need to do, including the checks that catch what an agent got wrong. We ship in short cycles in product teams with mixed specialisations. We pair often, with each other and with an agent open. Every quarter you get time to build and ship one of your own ideas, and we run hackathons. Must-haves 3+ years of professional experience with an SPA framework, Angular preferred. jobs.title: Account Executive - NL Region
jobs.description: Dit is Shiftbase Meer dan 10.000 bedrijven. Ruim 250.000 gebruikers. Eén missie: personeelsplanning en tijdregistratie simpel maken. Ons platform is gebouwd om makkelijk, flexibel en schaalbaar te zijn, of je klant nu 15 of 2500 medewerkers heeft. Vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Zoetermeer en onze hub in Amsterdam werken 85+ collega's aan een product waar bedrijven blij van worden. De sfeer? Open, informeel en hands-on. Hier geen eindeloze vergadercycli. Wel korte lijnen, snelle beslissingen en ruimte om jezelf te zijn. Wat ga je doen? Als Account Executive voor de Nederlandse markt ben jij de persoon die kansen omzet in betalende klanten. Je bedient de B2B-markt over de volle breedte: van horeca tot retail, van zorg tot transport. Bedrijven die vaak nog met Excel of een verouderd systeem werken en waarbij jij in één demo laat zien hoeveel tijd ze terugkrijgen. De use case is herkenbaar, de waarde is snel duidelijk en dat maakt je verkoopcycli lekker kort. Het grootste deel van je pipeline is warm. Onze marketing levert continu leads aan van bedrijven die actief op zoek zijn, en dat gaat hard. Maar we willen niet afhankelijk zijn van alleen wat er binnenkomt. Je krijgt de ruimte, en de verwachting, om zelf ook kansen te creëren in accounts die je interessant vindt. Hoe we dat als team het beste aanpakken, bepalen we samen. Jouw ervaring in de praktijk weegt daarin mee. Het volledige sales process is van jou, van discovery en demo tot onderhandeling en close. Na de close draag je het account over aan ons Customer Success-team. Jij focust volledig op new business. Je werkt met tempo en volume, en je weet wanneer een deal aandacht verdient en wanneer je hem moet laten gaan. Je dag bestaat voor een groot deel uit bellen en demo's, want dit is een hands-on salesrol. Sporadisch ga je op pad naar een klant voor een persoonlijk gesprek. Je bouwt mee aan een groeiend salesteam binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie, en dat vraagt energie, initiatief en doorzettingsvermogen. Je deelt wat voor jou werkt met het team, want we worden hier beter van elkaar. Wie ben jij? Een salesprofessional met een paar jaar ervaring die energie krijgt van tempo, van veel gesprekken en van scoren. Je hebt bewezen dat je kunt presteren in een snelle SaaS-salesomgeving en je wilt nu een volgende stap zetten in een team dat hard aan het opbouwen is. Je wacht niet tot de telefoon gaat: als je een account in gedachten hebt, vind je zelf een weg naar binnen. Verder herkennen we je aan het volgende: je hebt minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in high-velocity software sales (SaaS), je bent commercieel scherp zonder je klant uit het oog te verliezen, je bent leergierig en staat open voor coaching, en je beheerst Nederlands uitstekend. Engels is een pre. Profielen die ons aanspreken: je komt uit de SaaS-wereld en hebt ervaring met snelle funnels en hoge volumes. Denk aan omgevingen zoals Lightspeed, Zenchef of vergelijkbare SME-gerichte hospitality- of retailtech. Of je hebt een leidinggevende achtergrond in de horeca, bent tech-savvy en hebt slimme techoplossingen geïmplementeerd in die rol, en je wilt nu de overstap maken naar software sales aan onder andere de horeca. In beide gevallen: je snapt de wereld van onze klanten als geen ander. Wat bieden wij jou? Een rol waarin je een SaaS-oplossing verkoopt die bedrijven écht vooruit helpt, in een omgeving waar resultaat en plezier hand in hand gaan. Groei is hier geen loze belofte. We investeren serieus in je ontwikkeling vanaf dag één. Je start met een gedegen 30-60-90-dagen-onboardingprogramma met duidelijke milestones, zodat je precies weet waar je staat en waar je naartoe werkt. Je wordt daarnaast getraind en gecertificeerd via Winning by Design, hét toonaangevende salestrainingsprogramma voor SaaS, inclusief SPICED-certificering. Daarbovenop krijg je een persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget van €1.000 per jaar om te investeren in wat jou verder brengt: cursussen, conferenties, boeken of coaching. Jij kiest. Verder bieden we een brutojaar

Our culture is built on our Triple E philosophy: Energy, Entrepreneurship, and Expertise . We operate with a vibrant, agile startup mentality and no corporate red tape. If you have an idea, you test it. If you see a friction point in a user journey, you fix it. We are expanding our Amsterdam headquarters and looking for a designer who ships: a UX/UI Designer who takes their own work from Figma all the way to a live Next.js production site. The Role This is not a classic handoff role. You design the experience and you publish it. Your Figma file becomes a live page because you built it, in Next.js, often the same week. Day to day you will design and ship high-converting landing pages, onboarding quiz funnels, and lifecycle emails; manage the websites they live on; and keep improving them with CRO experiments. AI-assisted building ("vibe coding" with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, or v0) is core to how this role works, not a side experiment. You will touch several verticals and own things end to end: design, build, CMS, tracking, iteration. What You’ll Do Design and publish, yourself: Map user journeys, wireframe, design high-fidelity screens in Figma, then build and deploy them in Next.js. No waiting on a dev sprint. Own the website stack: Manage our sites end to end. Set up and maintain a headless CMS so the team can edit content without touching code, and keep deployments, domains, and tracking healthy. Run optimisations and CRO: Analyze user behavior and funnel data, form hypotheses, ship A/B tests, and iterate based on real performance metrics. Work across verticals: Landing pages are the core, but you will also design and build onboarding quiz flows and email campaigns, so the same brain covers the whole funnel. Frontrun with AI: Actively use AI design and coding tools to collapse the distance between idea and live page. Prototype in hours, ship in days. Who You Are The sweet-spot experienced: 2–4 years as a UX/UI, product, or web designer, with shipped web work to show for it (conversion-driven e-commerce or startup experience is a major plus). Master of Figma: Clean component-based design systems, auto-layout, interactive prototypes. You publish, not just hand off: Comfortable enough with Next.js, React, and Tailwind (with AI tools doing the heavy lifting) to take your own design live in production. You don’t need to be a senior engineer. You need to ship. Infrastructure doesn’t scare you: Hosting and deployments (e.g. Vercel), domains and DNS, analytics and tracking scripts, and headless CMS setup (Sanity, Contentful, Payload, or similar) are things you can figure out and own. Data-informed and AI-native: You design what works, not just what looks good. You read funnel data, session recordings, and test results, and you turn them into the next iteration. Thrives in a dynamic culture: Rapid A/B testing, quick iterations, shifting priorities based on performace data. You enjoy that. Portfolio driven: Live URLs beat static mocks. jobs.title: Senior Voice Routing Specialist
jobs.description: The Challenge We connect over 500’000 callers in 190 countries: that represents 36,000 calling corridors and over 100 million calling minutes. We work with various global suppliers optimising for call quality. It’s complex. Each calling corridor has its own quality quirks and legal and regulatory rules to work within. We want someone to own call quality and routing holistically across all of it: routing daily to optimize what's happening right now, while watching the data for the long-term trends that tell us where to fix things next. A failed call is not a metric to us. It's someone not hearing their mother's voice or its an important business call that fails. We also have real ambitions to scale calling well beyond where we are today, so this complexity isn't going anywhere. It's only going to grow. Talk360 has been profitable since 2025, expanding beyond our core calling app into embedded, B2B2C calling for partners. We are lean, around 30 people globally, spread across the Netherlands, South Africa, Nigeria, Suriname, Turkey, Egypt, Kenya, Ukraine, and beyond. jobs.title: Senior Acquisition Marketeer
jobs.description: The Challenge Talk360 connects more than 6 million people across 190 countries. How they find us is changing fast: Search is moving from blue links to AI generated answers and paid and organic increasingly shape each other. A missed opportunity here isn't just a lower ROAS number. It's someone staying connected with family abroad, a business trying to reach a supplier, or someone who urgently needs to reach a real phone number. As our Senior Acquisition Marketeer, you won't own a channel. You'll own the outcome: Figuring out where Talk360's next valuable user is and the smartest way to reach them, across Google, Meta, TikTok, SEO, app stores, AI search, and whatever comes next. Think investment manager for acquisition, not channel specialist. Talk360 has been profitably growing since 2025. We're a lean team of around 30 people, with the majority of team working from the Amsterdam office. We're looking for someone genuinely channel agnostic: you don't wake up thinking about Google Ads or SEO; you wake up thinking about where the next valuable Talk360 user is. What you’ll do Own the acquisition portfolio: Continuously evaluate and reallocate investment across paid channels (Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta, TikTok) and organic channels (SEO, ASO, content), based on where the next euro or hour of effort returns the most. Run segment-led acquisition: Adapt proposition, creative, keywords, landing pages, and app store presence for our three core segments, Calling Home, Calling for Work, and Calling When It Counts, and learn which segment performs best in which channel, market, and corridor. Connect acquisition to LTV: Track performance past the click or install, through registration, first purchase, calling behaviour, and retention, so decisions get made on CAC and LTV together, not platform ROAS alone. Build our AI discovery presence: Develop Talk360's approach to discovery as more of our future users start their search inside AI tools instead of Google. Run a continuous experimentation pipeline: Turn acquisition hypotheses (a new high-intent search category, a different proposition, an underserved corridor, a new distribution channel) into small, fast tests, and turn the results into investment decisions. The Team You’ll join a lean Commercial team where acquisition, brand, product marketing, CRM, content and data work closely together. No big silos or layers of approval: You’ll work directly with product, data and creative to turn an insight into a live experiment quickly. What you’ll bring Strong experience running paid acquisition on Google Ads, Meta, and/or Apple Search Ads, with real budget ownership and results to show for it. Working knowledge of SEO and ASO, and a track record of building organic acquisition that compounds rather than resetting every quarter. Fluency in CAC, ROAS, conversion, ARPU, and LTV, and the ability to build one framework that lets you compare channels that have never been compared before. Comfort moving between data, creative, content, and technology to shorten the distance between an idea and a live experiment. Active, current use of AI in your own marketing workflow, for research, analysis, content variation, and speeding up execution, not just openness to using it. Who you are Channel agnostic and opportunity driven, you're motivated by finding the next valuable user, not by defending a particular channel or discipline. Comfortable moving investment away from something that isn't working anymore, even if you're the one who built it. Genuinely curious about how AI is reshaping search and discovery and energised by figuring out a playbook that doesn't exist yet rather than waiting for one. Analytical: You can find the meaningful signal inside a pile of noisy performance data and act on it. Understand the limits of attribution and don't let an imperfect model stop you from making a call. You’re able to come to our office in Amsterdam on Mondays, Wednesday and Thursdays Recruitment process First

jobs.title: Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Tired of being told “that’s not your scope”? Plenty of good analysts hit the same wall: you query the data but never build the pipelines, you’re boxed into one lane, and more scope means waiting your turn. Here, it’s the opposite. Taptap Send moves billions of dollars a month across 6 of 7 continents . We’re probably the largest, fastest-growing money movement business you’ve never heard of. Cards, wallets, business-to-business payments, institutional payments, and new markets are all launching now, and each needs its data, reconciliations and reporting built from scratch. That’s your work. The job You’ll own the external reports the business can’t operate without, then automate them into reliable, reusable dbt models. From day one you’ll work with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product and Data Engineering to make sure every number is modelled correctly. Own external reporting: deliver the datasets behind month-end close and regulatory reporting, on time, every cycle. Automate: turn multi-day manual work into scheduled pipelines, runbooks and dbt models, so it only gets done once. Get ahead of launches: build reports and reconciliations as each product and market goes live, before anyone asks. Be first line for data requests: build models so people and AI agents can answer repeat questions themselves. Keep data trustworthy: build tests, checks and alerts that catch reconciliation breaks and stale data before they become incidents. Share what you know: peer-review code and join our weekly meetups. Why you’ll want it Grow as fast as you’re able. We hire for potential, not years of experience. On a lean, talent-dense team, you’ll own real work early and take on more the moment you’re ready. Go from querying data to designing systems. Data, product or business analyst? You don’t need to be an analytics engineer yet. Build the pipelines behind the numbers, and learn dbt, testing, automation and AI tooling from senior analytics engineers. Don't get boxed in. Own the reporting, automate it, then take on our biggest problems wherever they sit. Your hiring manager started in Finance and has since worked across Partner Ops, Fraud, Compliance, Reconciliation and Product. See the whole business. You’ll follow a transfer from the moment a customer taps send, through partner payout and reconciliation, to the report a regulator reads. Own numbers that matter. Auditors and Finance rely on what you build. This isn’t a dashboard role. Put more money in families’ hands. Remittances are a lifeline for millions of families and are worth more than all foreign aid. Every report you automate helps us keep transfers cheap and reliable. You’ll fit if you have 1-2+ years in a data or analytics role A technical or quantitative degree, or equivalent experience Strong SQL and experience wrangling messy, complex data Some experience automating repetitive work (e.g. scripts, scheduled jobs) A strong sense of ownership: when something is broken, ownerless or late, you step in, fix it, and make sure it doesn’t happen again Reliability under deadlines, a “no task too small” attitude, and comfort chasing stakeholders The right to work in the UK Nice to have: startup or scale-up experience, Python or R, dbt, Looker or Mode, and something you’ve built, at work or on the side, because the manual way annoyed you. Sound like you? Apply, even if you don’t tick every box. We’d love to meet you. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
